words.enDefinition: the salty fluid that comes out through the skin when the body is hot, ill, or frightened

examples.en: After an hour in the gym, my shirt was soaked with sweat.
examples.zh: 在健身房练了一个小时，我的衬衫都被「汗」浸透了。

examples.en: The doctor asked whether he had night sweats or a fever.
examples.zh: 医生问他有没有夜间「盗汗」或发烧。

words.enDefinition: a way of pronouncing a language that shows where a person is from; also stress on a syllable

examples.en: She kept her Scottish accent after twenty years in London.
examples.zh: 在伦敦住了二十年，她仍然保留着苏格兰「口音」。

examples.en: Say the word again and put the accent on the first syllable.
examples.zh: 再说一遍这个词，把「重音」放在第一个音节上。

words.enDefinition: acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing

examples.en: He called to apologize for missing my birthday dinner last night.
examples.zh: 他打电话来为错过我的生日晚宴「道歉」。

examples.en: If you broke it, apologize honestly and offer to pay.
examples.zh: 如果是你弄坏的，就诚恳地「道歉」并主动赔偿。

words.enDefinition: the thick short innermost digit of the forelimb

examples.en: He pressed his thumb against the clay to make a dent.
examples.zh: 他用「拇指」在黏土上按出一个凹痕。

examples.en: Hitchhikers raise their thumb politely to ask for a ride.
examples.zh: 搭车的人竖起「大拇指」请求搭便车。

words.enDefinition: your name written in your own handwriting

examples.en: The bank clerk asked for my signature on the form.
examples.zh: 银行职员要求我在表格上「签名」。

examples.en: Her signature at the bottom of the card was tiny and neat.
examples.zh: 她在贺卡底部的「签名」小巧而工整。

words.enDefinition: steep place (as on a hill)

examples.en: Our bikes skidded as we came down the steep behind the village.
examples.zh: 我们从村后的「陡坡」下来时，自行车打滑了。

examples.en: Climbers roped up before tackling the steep near the ridge.
examples.zh: 攀岩者在挑战山脊附近的「陡峭处」前先系好了绳索。

words.enDefinition: depression of a button on a computer mouse

examples.en: I heard the click of the key turning in the front door.
examples.zh: 我听到钥匙转动前门锁时发出的「咔哒」声。

examples.en: With one click of the camera, the whole family froze smiling.
examples.zh: 相机「咔哒」一声，全家定格在笑容里。

words.enDefinition: folded section placed between the leaves of another publication

examples.en: The magazine includes a glossy insert about the new phones.
examples.zh: 这本杂志里夹着一页关于新款手机的印刷「插页」。

examples.en: She slipped the photo insert into the back of the album.
examples.zh: 她把相片「插页」塞进了相册的最后一页。

words.enDefinition: a small package or container holding a small amount of something

examples.en: Stir a packet of sugar into your coffee if it tastes bitter.
examples.zh: 咖啡若发苦，就加一「小包」糖搅一搅。

examples.en: He tore open a packet of crisps on the school bus.
examples.zh: 他在校车上撕开了一「包」薯片。

words.enDefinition: sudden attack of fear

examples.en: The sudden bang from the kitchen gave us all a scare.
examples.zh: 厨房里突然的巨响让我们大家都受了「惊吓」。

examples.en: There was a fire scare at the hotel, so everyone waited outside.
examples.zh: 酒店因火警「虚惊」一场，大家都到外面等候。

words.enDefinition: impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on

examples.en: Teachers should not punish the whole class for one student's mistake.
examples.zh: 老师不应该因为一个学生的错误「惩罚」全班。

examples.en: The referee can punish dirty play with a red card.
examples.zh: 裁判可以用红牌「处罚」恶意犯规。

words.enDefinition: (mathematics) one of a set of parallel geometric figures (parallel lines or planes)

examples.en: Draw two parallel lines across the top of the page.
examples.zh: 在页面顶端画两条「平行线」。

examples.en: The railway and the road run parallel for three miles.
examples.zh: 铁路与公路「平行」延伸了三英里。

words.enDefinition: sculpture representing a human or animal

examples.en: Pigeons perch on the bronze statue in the town square.
examples.zh: 鸽子栖息在镇广场那座青铜「雕像」上。

examples.en: They unveiled a statue of the poet outside the library.
examples.zh: 他们在图书馆外为诗人的「雕像」揭幕。

words.enDefinition: purple color or pigment

examples.en: She dyed a streak of her hair bright purple for carnival.
examples.zh: 她把一缕头发染成了亮「紫色」。

examples.en: Purple grapes hung heavy and ripe on the vine in August.
examples.zh: 八月里，「紫色的」葡萄沉甸甸地挂在藤上。

words.enDefinition: almost; nearly

examples.en: There is practically nothing left in the fridge before payday.
examples.zh: 发工资前，冰箱里「几乎」什么都不剩。

examples.en: The twins are practically the same height now, which surprises everyone.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎现在「几乎」一样高，让大家都很意外。

words.enDefinition: feeling of dissatisfaction that results when your expectations are not realized

examples.en: Losing the final was a big disappointment for the whole team.
examples.zh: 决赛失利对全队来说是个巨大的「失望」。

examples.en: To her disappointment, the bakery had sold out of croissants.
examples.zh: 让她「失望」的是，面包店的牛角包已经卖完了。

words.enDefinition: transparent piece of diamond that has been cut and polished and is valued as a precious gem

examples.en: The tiny diamond in her ring caught the lamplight beautifully.
examples.zh: 她戒指上的小「钻石」映出了灯光。

examples.en: Grandma keeps her diamond brooch in the top drawer upstairs.
examples.zh: 奶奶把「钻石」胸针放在最上面的抽屉里。

words.enDefinition: surrounding or nearby region

examples.en: Our neighbourhood has a bakery, two parks, and one grumpy cat.
examples.zh: 我们的「街区」有一家面包店、两个公园和一只脾气暴躁的猫。

examples.en: Police patrols have made the neighbourhood much safer at night.
examples.zh: 警察巡逻让「附近一带」夜里安全多了。

words.enDefinition: written communication in a second language having the same meaning as the written communication in a first language

examples.en: The English translation of this novel loses some of the humour.
examples.zh: 这部小说的英「译本」丢失了一些幽默感。

examples.en: Check the translation of the instructions before you take the medicine.
examples.zh: 服药前先核对说明书的「翻译」。

words.enDefinition: in a strong substantial way

examples.en: Our rent went up substantially when the landlord renovated the building.
examples.zh: 房东翻修后，我们的房租「大幅」上涨。

examples.en: The new recipe is substantially cheaper than the old one.
examples.zh: 新配方的成本比旧的「低得多」。

words.enDefinition: having bad luck; marked by misfortune

examples.en: It was unfortunate that the ferry left minutes before we arrived.
examples.zh: 真是「不巧」，渡轮在我们到达前几分钟就开走了。

examples.en: An unfortunate accident kept the goalkeeper out for the whole season.
examples.zh: 一次「不幸的」意外让门将整个赛季都无法上场。

words.enDefinition: in a free manner

examples.en: In our meetings, everyone can speak freely without any interruption.
examples.zh: 在我们的会上，每个人都可以「畅所欲言」。

examples.en: The rescued deer now roam freely through the forest reserve.
examples.zh: 获救的鹿如今在森林保护区里「自由自在」地活动。

words.enDefinition: precise; explicit and clearly defined

examples.en: Give me a definite answer by Friday, either yes or no.
examples.zh: 周五前给我一个「明确的」答复，行还是不行。

examples.en: There is a definite improvement in his handwriting this term.
examples.zh: 这学期他的书写有「明显的」进步。

words.enDefinition: not easily bent or moved; rigid and firm

examples.en: These new hiking boots are stiff until you break them in.
examples.zh: 这双新登山鞋没穿开之前会很「硬」。

examples.en: The paintbrush had gone stiff, so we soaked it in water.
examples.zh: 画笔已经「变硬」了，我们把它泡进了水里。

words.enDefinition: spatially or metaphorically from a lower to a higher position

examples.en: He tilted his head upwards to watch the fireworks explode.
examples.zh: 他「仰起头」观看烟花。

examples.en: This swimming class suits children aged eight years and upwards.
examples.zh: 这个游泳班适合八岁及「以上」的孩子。

words.enDefinition: message that seems to convey no meaning

examples.en: Stop talking nonsense and tell me what really happened yesterday.
examples.zh: 别再说「胡话」了，告诉我到底发生了什么。

examples.en: The rumour that the school will close is complete nonsense.
examples.zh: 学校要关闭的传闻纯属「无稽之谈」。

words.enDefinition: having an import not apparent to the senses nor obvious to the intelligence; beyond ordinary understanding

examples.en: A mysterious parcel appeared on the doorstep with no sender.
examples.zh: 门口出现了一个「神秘的」包裹，没有寄件人。

examples.en: She smiled in a mysterious way and refused to explain.
examples.zh: 她「神秘兮兮地」笑了笑，拒绝解释。

words.enDefinition: causing inconvenience

examples.en: There was an awkward silence after his joke fell flat.
examples.zh: 他的笑话没人笑，接着是一阵「尴尬的」沉默。

examples.en: The new ladder feels awkward to carry around the garden.
examples.zh: 这架新梯子在花园里搬来搬去很「不顺手」。

words.enDefinition: hollow globule of gas (e.g., air or carbon dioxide)

examples.en: Bubbles rose steadily to the surface as the kettle boiled.
examples.zh: 水壶烧开时，「气泡」不断升上水面。

examples.en: The kids chased soap bubbles across the lawn all afternoon.
examples.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在草坪上追着「泡泡」跑。

words.enDefinition: (of a solid) to mix with a liquid and become part of it

examples.en: Stir until the sugar dissolves completely in the warm milk.
examples.zh: 搅拌直到糖在温牛奶中完全「溶解」。

examples.en: Effervescent tablets dissolve faster in hot water than in cold.
examples.zh: 泡腾片在热水里比在冷水里「溶」得快。

words.enDefinition: an area of a sea, lake, or river where the water is not deep

examples.en: Let the children paddle in the shallow near the river bank.
examples.zh: 让孩子们在河岸边的「浅水区」戏水。

examples.en: Fish gather in the warm shallow where the river widens.
examples.zh: 鱼群聚在河道变宽处的「浅滩」上。

words.enDefinition: mark to indicate a direction or relation

examples.en: Follow the green arrow signs to reach the departure gate.
examples.zh: 跟着绿色「箭头」走就能到登机口。

examples.en: A downward arrow on the screen means there are more menu options.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的向下「箭头」表示还有更多菜单选项。

words.enDefinition: full of life and energy

examples.en: The market is lively and colourful even on cold weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 即使在寒冷的工作日早晨，市场也很「热闹」。

examples.en: Our new puppy is lively from the moment she wakes.
examples.zh: 我们的新小狗一醒来就「活力十足」。

words.enDefinition: person who rules or commands

examples.en: The museum shows how the old ruler unified the region.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了这位古代「统治者」如何统一该地区。

examples.en: Villagers still tell stories about a just ruler from long ago.
examples.zh: 村民们仍在讲述很久以前一位公正「君主」的故事。

words.enDefinition: to produce young or offspring of the same kind

examples.en: Rabbits reproduce very quickly when food and shelter are plentiful.
examples.zh: 在食物和住处充足时，兔子「繁殖」得很快。

examples.en: These orchids reproduce by splitting at the root each spring.
examples.zh: 这些兰花每年春天靠根部分株来「繁殖」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a garment that is attached at the armhole and that provides a cloth covering for the arm

examples.en: He rolled up his sleeve before washing the dinner dishes.
examples.zh: 洗碗之前他把「袖子」卷了起来。

examples.en: A loose button dangles from the cuff of this old sleeve.
examples.zh: 这条旧「袖子」的袖口上挂着一颗松动的扣子。

words.enDefinition: boxlike container in a piece of furniture; made so as to slide in and out

examples.en: The spare keys always live in the messy kitchen drawer.
examples.zh: 备用钥匙一直放在乱糟糟的厨房「抽屉」里。

examples.en: She keeps her passport in a drawer beside the bed.
examples.zh: 她把护照放在床边的「抽屉」里。

words.enDefinition: good-natured tolerance of delay or incompetence

examples.en: Teaching a small toddler to tie laces takes real patience.
examples.zh: 教幼儿系鞋带非常考验人的「耐性」。

examples.en: After the third long delay, even calm travellers lost patience.
examples.zh: 第三次延误之后，连沉稳的旅客也失去了「耐心」。

words.enDefinition: any person who; the person that

examples.en: Whoever finishes the puzzle first gets the last slice of pizza.
examples.zh: 「无论谁」先拼好拼图，最后一块披萨就归谁。

examples.en: Please hand these concert flyers to whoever waits at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 请把这些演出传单交给在公交站「等车的任何人」。

words.enDefinition: the expression of approval and support

examples.en: A little encouragement from the coach lifted the whole team.
examples.zh: 教练的一点点「鼓励」提振了全队的士气。

examples.en: His quiet encouragement from the sidelines helped me finish my first marathon.
examples.zh: 他默默的「鼓励」帮我跑完了人生第一场马拉松。

words.enDefinition: showing that you understand and care about someone's problems; feeling or expressing sympathy

examples.en: The nurse gave a sympathetic nod and brought warm water.
examples.zh: 护士「同情地」点点头，端来了温水。

examples.en: Our manager is sympathetic whenever someone has a family emergency.
examples.zh: 每当有人家里有急事，我们经理都很有「同情心」。

words.enDefinition: (usually plural) valuables taken by violence (especially in war)

examples.en: The victorious generals divided the spoils of the ancient campaign.
examples.zh: 获胜的将领们瓜分了那场古代战役的「战利品」。

examples.en: The pirates buried their stolen spoils on a deserted island.
examples.zh: 海盗们把「掠来的财物」埋在一座荒岛上。

words.enDefinition: not present in a place or at an event

examples.en: Three players are absent from training because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因为暴风雨，三名队员「缺席」了训练。

examples.en: The teacher marks pupils absent if they miss the morning roll call.
examples.zh: 如果学生没到早晨点名，老师就把他们记为「缺席」。

words.enDefinition: an empty space, especially one to be filled in on a form or document

examples.en: Write your full address in the blank at the top of the form.
examples.zh: 把你的完整地址写在表格顶端的「空格」里。

examples.en: Every blank in the crossword defeated us except the last one.
examples.zh: 填字游戏里除了最后一个，每个「空格」都难住了我们。

words.enDefinition: dense crowd of people

examples.en: There was a terrible crush on the metro at rush hour.
examples.zh: 早高峰时段，地铁里是一片「拥挤的人潮」。

examples.en: Stewards managed the crush of fans outside the stadium gate.
examples.zh: 工作人员在球场门口疏导着「拥挤的球迷人群」。

words.enDefinition: piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container and a handle; used to stir or serve or take up food

examples.en: Stir the porridge with a wooden spoon until it thickens.
examples.zh: 用木「勺」把粥搅到变稠。

examples.en: There is an extra spoon beside the sugar bowl for guests.
examples.zh: 糖罐旁边多放了一把「勺子」给客人用。

words.enDefinition: substance that is liquid at room temperature and pressure

examples.en: Pour the hot liquid slowly so it does not splash anyone.
examples.zh: 慢慢倒热「液体」，免得溅到人。

examples.en: Water is the most common liquid found in every kitchen.
examples.zh: 水是每个厨房里最常见的「液体」。

words.enDefinition: wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals

examples.en: She rides her bicycle to school even in light rain.
examples.zh: 即使下小雨，她也骑「自行车」上学。

examples.en: Dad repaired the flat tyre on my bicycle last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚爸爸修好了我「自行车」上瘪掉的车胎。

words.enDefinition: deception for profit to yourself

examples.en: The hidden notes in his sleeve were an obvious cheat.
examples.zh: 他袖子里藏着小抄，显然是一种「欺骗」。

examples.en: This lottery email is just a cheat to get your bank details.
examples.zh: 这封中奖邮件不过是骗取银行信息的「欺骗手段」。

words.enDefinition: child of your son or daughter

examples.en: Every grandchild receives a hand-knitted scarf from Grandma each winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，奶奶都会给每个「孙子孙女」织一条围巾。

examples.en: The old photograph shows our first grandchild on the farm.
examples.zh: 这张老照片上是我们在农场里的第一个「孙子」。

words.enDefinition: thin cylindrical pointed writing implement; a rod of marking substance encased in wood

examples.en: Sharpen your pencil properly before the still-life drawing class begins.
examples.zh: 静物写生课开始前先削好「铅笔」。

examples.en: He sketched the little harbour with a soft grey pencil.
examples.zh: 他用一支软灰「铅笔」勾画了小小的海港。

words.enDefinition: having or showing great excitement and interest

examples.en: The new volunteers were truly enthusiastic about the beach clean-up.
examples.zh: 新志愿者们对海滩清洁活动「满怀热忱」。

examples.en: Grandpa gave an enthusiastic thumbs-up to my very first attempt.
examples.zh: 爷爷对我第一次尝试「热情地」竖起了大拇指。

words.enDefinition: steadfast in allegiance or duty

examples.en: Our old dog stayed loyal to the family through three moves.
examples.zh: 我们的老狗经历了三次搬家，对家人始终「忠诚」。

examples.en: She has been a loyal customer of that bakery for ten years.
examples.zh: 十年来她一直是那家面包店的「忠实」顾客。

words.enDefinition: openly distrustful and unwilling to confide

examples.en: The guard grew suspicious when the visitor avoided the camera.
examples.zh: 访客躲着摄像头，警卫起了「疑心」。

examples.en: There is a suspicious van parked outside the school gates.
examples.zh: 校门外停着一辆「可疑的」面包车。

words.enDefinition: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering

examples.en: It is cruel to leave a dog chained outside in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天把狗拴在门外太「残忍」了。

examples.en: Those cruel comments online upset her for the whole weekend.
examples.zh: 网上那些「刻薄的」话让她难过了整个周末。

words.enDefinition: the light horny waterproof structure forming the external covering of birds

examples.en: A single white feather drifted slowly onto the picnic blanket.
examples.zh: 一根白色「羽毛」飘落在野餐毯上。

examples.en: The old pillow is stuffed with soft goose feathers, not foam.
examples.zh: 这个旧枕头塞的是柔软的鹅「羽毛」，不是海绵。

words.enDefinition: schedule listing events and the times at which they will take place

examples.en: The new bus timetable starts next Monday, so check before travelling.
examples.zh: 新的公交「时刻表」下周一生效，出行前请查看。

examples.en: Pin the exam timetable above your desk where you can see it.
examples.zh: 把考试「时间表」钉在书桌上方显眼的位置。

words.enDefinition: something used to beautify

examples.en: Grandma's favourite Christmas decoration is the star for the tree.
examples.zh: 奶奶最喜欢的圣诞「装饰」是挂在树上的那颗星。

examples.en: They hung paper chains as decoration for the school festival.
examples.zh: 他们挂起纸链为校园节做「装饰」。

words.enDefinition: feeling tired and impatient because nothing interesting is happening

examples.en: The kids got bored and restless during the long train journey.
examples.zh: 长途火车上，孩子们觉得「无聊」了。

examples.en: He yawned loudly, clearly bored with the long history lecture.
examples.zh: 他大声打着哈欠，显然对历史课感到「厌烦」。

words.enDefinition: the activity of worshipping

examples.en: Families gathered at the little temple for their Sunday worship.
examples.zh: 家家户户到小庙里参加周日的「崇拜」活动。

examples.en: His worship of that rock band borders on true obsession.
examples.zh: 他对那个摇滚乐队的「崇拜」近乎痴迷。

words.enDefinition: direct the course; determine the direction of travelling

examples.en: Steer the heavy shopping trolley carefully around the corner display.
examples.zh: 推购物车过转角的陈列架时要小心「转向」。

examples.en: She quickly steered the conversation away from her exam results.
examples.zh: 她巧妙地把话题从考试成绩上「引开」。

words.enDefinition: a mark or slight wound made by scraping with something sharp or rough

examples.en: The cat left a long scratch on the wooden chair.
examples.zh: 猫在木椅上留下一道长长的「抓痕」。

examples.en: He bandaged the scratch from the thorn bush at once.
examples.zh: 他立刻包扎了被荆棘丛划出的「划伤」。

words.enDefinition: not in a state of sleep; completely conscious

examples.en: The baby is finally wide awake after a long nap.
examples.zh: 长长的午觉之后，宝宝终于「醒了」。

examples.en: I was still awake at midnight, listening to the rain.
examples.zh: 午夜时分我还「醒着」，听着窗外的雨声。

words.enDefinition: the hair growing on the lower part of a man's face

examples.en: Grandpa trims his long white beard carefully every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 爷爷每周日早上修剪他那长长的白色「胡须」。

examples.en: The sailor grew a thick beard during the long voyage.
examples.zh: 长途航行中，那个水手留起了浓密的「络腮胡」。

words.enDefinition: fine cord of twisted fibers (of cotton or silk or wool or nylon etc.) used in sewing and weaving

examples.en: The needle lost its thin thread halfway through the repair.
examples.zh: 缝补到一半，「线」从针上脱开了。

examples.en: Choose a bright red thread to match the quilt pattern.
examples.zh: 选一条红「线」来配被面的花纹。

words.enDefinition: disagreeable to the senses, to the mind, or feelings

examples.en: The medicine has an unpleasant taste, but it really works.
examples.zh: 这药「味道不好」，但确实有效。

examples.en: An unpleasant smell drifted in from the harbour at low tide.
examples.zh: 退潮时，一股难闻的「异味」从港口飘了过来。

words.enDefinition: simple machine of the inclined-plane type consisting of a spirally threaded cylindrical rod that engages with a similarly threaded hole

examples.en: One loose screw makes the whole bookshelf wobble when touched.
examples.zh: 一颗松动的「螺丝」让整个书架一碰就晃。

examples.en: Keep the small screws in a jar while assembling the desk.
examples.zh: 组装书桌时，把小「螺丝钉」收进罐子里。

words.enDefinition: an adornment (as a bracelet or ring or necklace) made of precious metals and set with gems (or imitation gems)

examples.en: She keeps her grandmother's jewellery in a small velvet box.
examples.zh: 她把奶奶传下来的「首饰」放在一个小天鹅绒盒子里。

examples.en: The shop cleaned my silver jewellery for free after the repair.
examples.zh: 修理之后，那家店免费清洁了我的银「首饰」。

words.enDefinition: an elastic material obtained from the latex sap of trees (especially trees of the genera Hevea and Ficus) that can be vulcanized and finished into a variety of products

examples.en: The rubber seals around the fridge door keep the cold air in.
examples.zh: 冰箱门周围的「橡胶」密封条把冷气锁在里面。

examples.en: Rain boots are made of rubber, so puddles are no problem.
examples.zh: 雨靴是「橡胶」做的，踩水洼完全没问题。

words.enDefinition: the undulating movement of the surface of the open sea

examples.en: A heavy swell rocked the fishing boats in the harbour.
examples.zh: 巨大的「涌浪」让港口里的渔船摇晃不停。

examples.en: Surfers love the long gentle swell that follows the storm.
examples.zh: 冲浪者喜欢风暴过后那绵长的「涌浪」。

words.enDefinition: speak, pronounce, or utter in a certain way

examples.en: How do you pronounce the old town's strange name correctly?
examples.zh: 这个古镇的名字应该怎么「发音」才对？

examples.en: The coach pronounces every player's name clearly at roll call.
examples.zh: 点名时教练把每个队员的名字都「念」得清清楚楚。

words.enDefinition: feeling of aversion or antipathy

examples.en: She has always had a strong dislike for crowded shopping malls.
examples.zh: 她对拥挤的购物中心有一种强烈的「嫌恶」。

examples.en: His dislike of getting up early is famous in our office.
examples.zh: 他「不喜欢」早起，这在我们办公室是出了名的。

words.enDefinition: the part of a gunlock that strikes the percussion cap when the trigger is pulled

examples.en: Fetch the hammer from the toolbox so we can hang the mirror.
examples.zh: 把「锤子」从工具箱里拿来，我们好挂镜子。

examples.en: One firm tap of the hammer straightened the bent nail.
examples.zh: 「锤子」轻轻一敲，就把弯钉子敲直了。

words.enDefinition: showing regard for others in manners, speech, behavior, etc.

examples.en: The new neighbour is always polite to everyone on our floor.
examples.zh: 新邻居对我们这层的每个人总是很有「礼貌」。

examples.en: It is polite to write a thank-you note after the dinner party.
examples.zh: 晚宴之后写一张感谢便条是有「礼貌」的表现。

words.enDefinition: being or in accordance with current social fashions

examples.en: Wide-brimmed straw hats are fashionable again on the beaches this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天，宽檐草帽在海滩上又「流行」起来。

examples.en: That cafe is fashionable with students because of the cheap coffee.
examples.zh: 因为咖啡便宜，那家咖啡馆在学生中很「时髦」。

words.enDefinition: any loyal and steadfast following

examples.en: She remained faithful to the team through every losing season.
examples.zh: 即使球队连年失利，她也始终是「忠实的」支持者。

examples.en: The film stays remarkably faithful to the original novel's plot.
examples.zh: 这部电影相当「忠实于」原著小说的情节。

words.enDefinition: combine by multiplication

examples.en: Multiply six by seven and write the answer down carefully.
examples.zh: 把六「乘」以七，把答案写下来。

examples.en: Online orders multiplied after the little shop joined the delivery app.
examples.zh: 小店上了外卖平台后，网上订单「成倍增加」。

words.enDefinition: any member of a ship's crew

examples.en: The old sailor taught us to tie three kinds of knots.
examples.zh: 那位老「水手」教我们打了三种绳结。

examples.en: Every careful sailor checks the weather before leaving the harbour.
examples.zh: 每个「水手」出海前都会查看天气。

words.enDefinition: being full of or promoting cheer; having or showing good spirits

examples.en: The cheerful young waitress remembered every regular customer's usual order.
examples.zh: 那位「乐呵呵的」服务员记得每位熟客常点的餐。

examples.en: The yellow curtains give the whole kitchen a cheerful look.
examples.zh: 黄色窗帘让整个厨房显得「明快」。

words.enDefinition: cause fear in

examples.en: Loud thunder does not frighten our old horse any more.
examples.zh: 响雷再也「吓」不到我们那匹老马了。

examples.en: Please do not frighten the pigeons away from the balcony.
examples.zh: 请别把阳台上的鸽子「吓跑」。

words.enDefinition: conflict of people's opinions or actions or characters

examples.en: The only disagreement at dinner was about pineapple on pizza.
examples.zh: 晚饭桌上唯一的「分歧」是披萨该不该放菠萝。

examples.en: After a short disagreement, the neighbours shared the hedge cost.
examples.zh: 短暂「争执」之后，邻居们分摊了修树篱的费用。

words.enDefinition: lack of ability (especially mental ability) to do something

examples.en: The report blamed the delay on the company's inability to hire drivers.
examples.zh: 报告把延误归咎于公司「无力」招聘到司机。

examples.en: His inability to swim kept him on the shore during the lake trip.
examples.zh: 湖边出游时，他因「不能」游泳只能待在岸上。

words.enDefinition: reflecting light

examples.en: Dad polished the old car until the paint was shiny.
examples.zh: 爸爸把旧车擦得漆面「锃亮」。

examples.en: The bakery's shiny trays gleamed under the warm counter lights.
examples.zh: 面包店「亮闪闪的」烤盘在暖黄的灯光下发光。

words.enDefinition: directed or facing toward the back or rear

examples.en: She leaned backward very quickly to avoid the low branch.
examples.zh: 她赶紧「向后」仰身躲开低垂的树枝。

examples.en: Count backward slowly from one hundred whenever you feel nervous.
examples.zh: 紧张的时候，从十慢慢「倒着」往回数。

words.enDefinition: cause to feel resentment or indignation

examples.en: His joke about her cooking did not mean to offend anyone.
examples.zh: 他拿她厨艺开的玩笑并非有意「冒犯」谁。

examples.en: Apologize quickly and sincerely if your words offend an elderly guest.
examples.zh: 如果你的话「得罪」了年长的客人，要赶快道歉。

words.enDefinition: the emotion of intense dislike; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action

examples.en: Old hatred between the two families finally ended at the wedding.
examples.zh: 在婚礼上，两家多年的「积怨」终于消解。

examples.en: He spoke about his hatred of unfair rules with surprising calm.
examples.zh: 他异常平静地谈起自己对不公规则的「憎恨」。

words.enDefinition: feeling shame or guilt or embarrassment or remorse

examples.en: He felt deeply ashamed after shouting at his little brother.
examples.zh: 对弟弟大吼之后，他感到很「羞愧」。

examples.en: Do not be ashamed of asking simple questions in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上问简单的问题不必「难为情」。

words.enDefinition: arouse or elicit a feeling

examples.en: The sudden announcement of a snow day excited every pupil.
examples.zh: 停课的通知让每个小学生都「兴奋」起来。

examples.en: New dinosaur fossils never fail to excite the museum visitors.
examples.zh: 新化石总能「激起」博物馆参观者的兴趣。

words.enDefinition: device consisting of a set of keys on a piano or organ or typewriter or typesetting machine or computer or the like

examples.en: Crumbs under my keyboard keys make the letters stick badly.
examples.zh: 「键盘」键帽下的碎屑让字母键发黏卡顿。

examples.en: She plays simple folk tunes on the keyboard after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后她在「电子琴」上弹几支简单的小曲。

words.enDefinition: refrigerator in which the coolant is pumped around by an electric motor

examples.en: There is nothing but mustard in the fridge before payday.
examples.zh: 发工资前，「冰箱」里除了芥末什么都没有。

examples.en: Put the milk back in the fridge right after breakfast.
examples.zh: 早饭后立刻把牛奶放回「冰箱」。

words.enDefinition: person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant)

examples.en: The waiter quickly brought extra napkins when the soup spilled.
examples.zh: 汤洒了，「服务员」马上多拿了几张餐巾纸。

examples.en: Our friendly waiter recommended the grilled fish over the stew.
examples.zh: 我们的「侍应生」推荐点烤鱼而不是炖菜。

words.enDefinition: with little or no delay

examples.en: The hotel fixed the leaky tap promptly after our call.
examples.zh: 我们打电话后，酒店「立即」修好了漏水的水龙头。

examples.en: Pay the small library fine promptly to avoid extra charges.
examples.zh: 请「及时」缴付图书馆罚款，以免产生额外费用。

words.enDefinition: any substance that causes injury or illness or death of a living organism

examples.en: Keep rat poison locked away from curious pets and children.
examples.zh: 把灭鼠「毒药」锁好，别让好奇的宠物和孩子碰到。

examples.en: Some pretty wild mushrooms contain a deadly poison for humans.
examples.zh: 有些漂亮的野蘑菇含有对人类致命的「毒药」。

words.enDefinition: on the lower or downward side; on the underside of

examples.en: The cat loves sleeping underneath the warm printer after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，猫喜欢睡在暖烘烘的打印机「下面」。

examples.en: Remember to check underneath the car for oil leaks every month.
examples.zh: 每月记得查看汽车「底下」有没有漏油。

words.enDefinition: farewell remark

examples.en: We waved goodbye to the guests from the front step.
examples.zh: 我们在前门台阶上向客人们挥手「道别」。

examples.en: Say goodbye to Grandma properly before your early train leaves.
examples.zh: 火车开车前，好好和奶奶说「再见」。

words.enDefinition: not disposed or inclined toward

examples.en: The old cat was unwilling to leave the sunny windowsill.
examples.zh: 猫咪「不愿意」离开晒着太阳的窗台。

examples.en: He was unwilling to admit that the map was upside down.
examples.zh: 他「不肯」承认地图拿反了。

words.enDefinition: portable rectangular container for carrying clothes

examples.en: The old suitcase handle broke just before the airport check-in.
examples.zh: 就在机场值机前，「行李箱」的把手断了。

examples.en: Pack the heavy books at the bottom of the suitcase.
examples.zh: 把重书放在「行李箱」的最底下。

words.enDefinition: to a remarkable degree or extent

examples.en: The lake was unusually calm for such a windy morning.
examples.zh: 在这样一个刮风的早晨，湖面「异常」平静。

examples.en: She was unusually quiet at dinner, so we asked what happened.
examples.zh: 晚饭时她「格外」安静，于是我们问她怎么了。

words.enDefinition: aromatic substances of vegetable origin used as a preservative

examples.en: Add a pinch of spice to the soup for warmth.
examples.zh: 往汤里加一撮「香料」提味暖身。

examples.en: The market stall sells every spice a curry could need.
examples.zh: 那个市场摊位卖齐了做咖喱需要的各种「香料」。

words.enDefinition: not successful; having failed or having an unfavorable outcome

examples.en: Their first attempt to start the damp campfire was unsuccessful.
examples.zh: 他们第一次生营火「没有成功」。

examples.en: After an unsuccessful search, the family printed new posters for the cat.
examples.zh: 「寻找无果」后，一家人为走失的猫印了新的寻猫启事。

words.enDefinition: suspicious or unduly suspicious or fearful of being displaced by a rival

examples.en: The younger cat gets jealous whenever the puppy gets attention.
examples.zh: 每当小狗受到关注，小猫就「嫉妒」。

examples.en: Do not be jealous of her new bike; yours is faster.
examples.zh: 别「眼红」她的新自行车，你的更快。

words.enDefinition: the business of packing

examples.en: The toy's plastic packaging took longer to open than the toy itself.
examples.zh: 玩具的塑料「包装」比玩具本身还难拆。

examples.en: The recycling bins in our building accept clean paper packaging.
examples.zh: 我们楼的回收箱收干净的纸质「包装」。

words.enDefinition: metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions; now equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters (or approximately 1.75 pints)

examples.en: Buy a litre of milk and two red apples, please.
examples.zh: 请买一「升」牛奶和两个苹果。

examples.en: This little car engine holds exactly four litres of oil.
examples.zh: 这台汽车发动机正好装四「升」机油。

words.enDefinition: the act of removing hair with a razor

examples.en: Dad's quick Sunday shave before church takes exactly five minutes.
examples.zh: 爸爸去教堂前的快速「修面」正好花五分钟。

examples.en: A close shave needs warm water and a fresh blade.
examples.zh: 想把脸「刮」得干净，得用温水和崭新的刀片。

words.enDefinition: causing or capable of causing harm

examples.en: Reading in dim light is not harmful, despite what Grandpa says.
examples.zh: 尽管爷爷那么说，在昏暗灯光下看书并不「有害」。

examples.en: Chemical garden fertilizers can be harmful to the pond fish.
examples.zh: 化肥可能对池塘里的鱼「有害」。

words.enDefinition: to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth

examples.en: Old fishermen exaggerate the size of every fish they release.
examples.zh: 钓鱼的人总爱「夸大」放走的每条鱼的大小。

examples.en: Do not exaggerate the cost; the repair was only forty yuan.
examples.zh: 别「夸大」费用，修理只花了四十块。

words.enDefinition: an activity that you enjoy doing regularly in your free time

examples.en: Photography became her favourite hobby after she borrowed Dad's camera.
examples.zh: 借了爸爸的相机之后，摄影成了她的「爱好」。

examples.en: Model trains are a hobby that fills our whole garage.
examples.zh: 玩火车模型这个「爱好」占满了我们整个车库。

words.enDefinition: affording satisfaction or pleasure

examples.en: The guided city walk was surprisingly enjoyable despite the drizzle.
examples.zh: 尽管下着毛毛雨，这次城市导览步行还是很「愉快」。

examples.en: We spent a truly enjoyable evening swapping old travel stories.
examples.zh: 我们整晚交换旅途旧事，过得非常「开心」。

words.enDefinition: the process of gradually becoming inferior

examples.en: Neglect led to the slow decay of the old theatre.
examples.zh: 长年失修让那座老剧院逐渐「衰败」。

examples.en: Sweet fizzy drinks speed up tooth decay in young children.
examples.zh: 甜味汽水会加快幼儿「蛀牙」的速度。

words.enDefinition: moist as with undried perspiration and with clothing sticking to the body

examples.en: The picnic table was sticky with spilt lemonade and jam.
examples.zh: 野餐桌上洒了柠檬水和果酱，「黏糊糊的」。

examples.en: The humid August weather makes every doorknob in the house feel sticky.
examples.zh: 八月潮湿的天气让家里每个门把手都发「黏」。

words.enDefinition: located, suited for, or taking place within a building

examples.en: The community centre has an indoor pool for winter swims.
examples.zh: 社区中心有一个「室内」泳池，冬天也能游泳。

examples.en: Old cats prefer indoor naps when the wind picks up.
examples.zh: 起风的时候，猫咪更喜欢在「室内」打盹。

words.enDefinition: serving an esthetic rather than a useful purpose

examples.en: The carved wooden spoons are decorative, not for daily cooking.
examples.zh: 这些雕花木勺是「装饰性的」，不是日常做饭用的。

examples.en: A decorative border runs along the top of the wallpaper.
examples.zh: 壁纸顶部有一圈「装饰性的」花边。

words.enDefinition: posing no difficulty; requiring little effort

examples.en: The trail to the waterfall is easy enough for beginners.
examples.zh: 去瀑布的步道对新手来说足够「容易」。

examples.en: It was not an easy choice between the two flats.
examples.zh: 在两套公寓之间做选择并不「容易」。

words.enDefinition: become part of; become a member of a group or organization

examples.en: Would you like to join us for board games tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚要不要「加入」我们一起玩桌游？

examples.en: Twelve keen neighbours joined the Sunday morning street clean-up group.
examples.zh: 十二位邻居「参加」了周日早晨的街道清扫队。

words.enDefinition: installation from which a military force initiates operations

examples.en: His father served at an army base in the north.
examples.zh: 他父亲曾在北方的一个军事「基地」服役。

examples.en: The climbers set up a base camp below the glacier.
examples.zh: 登山者在冰川下建起了「基地营」。

words.enDefinition: (astronomy) a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear reactions in the interior

examples.en: We sat on the balcony and watched the stars appear.
examples.zh: 我们坐在阳台上看着「星星」出现。

examples.en: The children stuck gold star stickers on their finished charts.
examples.zh: 孩子们在完成的成绩表上贴上金色「星星」贴纸。

words.enDefinition: principle or condition that customarily governs behavior

examples.en: One rule in our house: shoes off at the door.
examples.zh: 我们家的一条「规矩」：进门脱鞋。

examples.en: The new library rules say no food or drinks upstairs.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「规定」说楼上禁止饮食。

words.enDefinition: an architectural partition with a height and length greater than its thickness; used to divide or enclose an area or to support another structure

examples.en: Someone painted a colourful mural on the old brick wall.
examples.zh: 有人在旧砖「墙」上画了一幅色彩鲜艳的壁画。

examples.en: Hang the round mirror on the wall above the fireplace.
examples.zh: 把镜子挂在壁炉上方的「墙」上。

words.enDefinition: information about recent and important events

examples.en: Did you hear the news about the new metro line?
examples.zh: 你听说新地铁线路的「消息」了吗？

examples.en: Bad news always travels fast in a small town like ours.
examples.zh: 在我们这样的小镇上，坏「消息」总是传得飞快。

words.enDefinition: any standardized procedure for measuring sensitivity or memory or intelligence or aptitude or personality etc

examples.en: I have a maths test tomorrow morning, so I revised late.
examples.zh: 明天早上有数学「测验」，所以我复习到很晚。

examples.en: The eye test at the clinic takes about ten minutes.
examples.zh: 诊所里的视力「检查」大约需要十分钟。

words.enDefinition: an action or stage in a sequence used to complete a task

examples.en: Follow the steps in the recipe one at a time.
examples.zh: 一次只做菜谱里的一个「步骤」。

examples.en: Moving to a new city was a big step for her.
examples.zh: 搬到新城市对她来说是「一大步」。

words.enDefinition: to try to find, obtain, or achieve something

examples.en: You should seek advice from a doctor before the long trip.
examples.zh: 长途旅行前你应该「咨询」医生的建议。

examples.en: The club is seeking volunteers for Saturday's charity bake sale.
examples.zh: 俱乐部正在为周六的慈善义卖「寻找」志愿者。

words.enDefinition: medium that disseminates moving pictures

examples.en: We rented a funny film and made popcorn at home.
examples.zh: 我们在家租了一部搞笑「电影」，还做了爆米花。

examples.en: The new film about the open ocean opens on Friday.
examples.zh: 那部关于大海的新「电影」周五上映。

words.enDefinition: having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other

examples.en: The new bridge is wide enough for four lanes of traffic.
examples.zh: 新桥很「宽」，足以容纳四条车道。

examples.en: He opened the windows wide to let the sea breeze in.
examples.zh: 他把窗户「大敞」，让海风吹进来。

words.enDefinition: the members of a business organization that owns or operates one or more establishments

examples.en: The family firm has baked bread here for three generations.
examples.zh: 这家家族「公司」三代人都在这里烤面包。

examples.en: She joined a small friendly law firm near the courthouse.
examples.zh: 她加入了法院附近的一家小型「律师事务所」。

words.enDefinition: in the near future

examples.en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands now.
examples.zh: 晚饭很快就「好」，现在去洗手吧。

examples.en: See you soon at the station after your train arrives.
examples.zh: 你的火车到站后，我们车站「很快见」。

words.enDefinition: fail to do something; leave something undone

examples.en: Our picnic plan failed completely because of the sudden rain.
examples.zh: 因为突然下雨，我们的野餐计划「失败」了。

examples.en: He failed the driving test twice before finally passing it.
examples.zh: 他考驾照「失败」了两次，第三次才通过。

words.enDefinition: growth in strength or number or importance

examples.en: The sharp rise in petrol prices hits daily commuters hard.
examples.zh: 油价的「上涨」让天天通勤的人压力很大。

examples.en: There has been a steady rise in visitors since spring.
examples.zh: 自春天以来，游客人数持续「上升」。

words.enDefinition: one side of one leaf (of a book or magazine or newspaper or letter etc.) or the written or pictorial matter it contains

examples.en: Tear out page twelve of the workbook for tonight's homework.
examples.zh: 撕下练习册的第十二「页」做今晚的作业。

examples.en: There is a photo of Grandma on the album's last page.
examples.zh: 相册最后一「页」有奶奶的照片。

words.enDefinition: the countries of (originally) Europe and (now including) North America and South America

examples.en: Trade between East and West has grown rapidly this decade.
examples.zh: 这十年间，东「西方」之间的贸易迅速增长。

examples.en: The novel contrasts village life in the East with the modern West.
examples.zh: 这部小说把东方的村庄生活与现代「西方」作了对比。

words.enDefinition: the time that has elapsed

examples.en: The old mill is a reminder of the village's past.
examples.zh: 这座老磨坊是这个村庄「过去」的见证。

examples.en: She often talks about her past as a sea captain.
examples.zh: 她常谈起自己当船长的那段「过去」。

words.enDefinition: not far distant in time or space or degree or circumstances

examples.en: We found a lovely little cafe near the railway station.
examples.zh: 我们在火车站「附近」找到一家可爱的小咖啡馆。

examples.en: The exam is near, so the library stays open late.
examples.zh: 考试「临近」，图书馆延长了开放时间。

words.enDefinition: a series of names or items written or printed one after another

examples.en: Add flour and birthday candles to the shopping list, please.
examples.zh: 请把面粉和蜡烛加进购物「清单」。

examples.en: Her name is at the top of the guest list.
examples.zh: 她的名字排在宾客「名单」的最上面。

words.enDefinition: any competition

examples.en: The relay race is the last event of sports day.
examples.zh: 接力「赛」是运动会最后一个项目。

examples.en: He trained hard all summer for the charity bike race.
examples.zh: 他为慈善自行车「比赛」训练了一整个夏天。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal compass point that is at 90 degrees

examples.en: The kitchen window faces east, so the mornings are bright.
examples.zh: 厨房窗户朝「东」，所以早晨很明亮。

examples.en: A cool wind blows from the east every single autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天常有凉风从「东方」吹来。

words.enDefinition: (sports) the act of preventing the opposition from scoring

examples.en: The goalkeeper's diving save kept us in the cup match.
examples.zh: 守门员的鱼跃「救球」让我们留在了杯赛里。

examples.en: Her fingertip save in the final second won the trophy.
examples.zh: 最后一秒她指尖的「救球」为球队捧回了奖杯。

words.enDefinition: reserve of money set aside for some purpose

examples.en: The school fund pays for new books in the library.
examples.zh: 学校「基金」用于为图书馆购置新书。

examples.en: They started a small fund to repair the village footbridge.
examples.zh: 他们设立了一项「基金」来修缮村里的人行桥。

words.enDefinition: perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)

examples.en: Look for the sign that points to the ferry terminal.
examples.zh: 找一找指向渡轮码头的「指示牌」。

examples.en: Dark heavy clouds are a sign that rain is coming.
examples.zh: 乌云是雨要来的「迹象」。

words.enDefinition: permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state

examples.en: His older brother joined the army right after finishing school.
examples.zh: 他哥哥一毕业就「参军」了。

examples.en: The local army unit helped clear fallen trees after the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴过后，「军队」帮助清理了倒伏的树木。

words.enDefinition: blue color or pigment; resembling the color of the clear sky in the daytime

examples.en: The nursery walls are painted a soft pale sky blue.
examples.zh: 育婴室的墙刷成了柔和的天「蓝色」。

examples.en: She chose a navy blue scarf to match her coat.
examples.zh: 她挑了一条深「蓝色」围巾来配大衣。

words.enDefinition: an emotion experienced in anticipation of some specific pain or danger (usually accompanied by a desire to flee or fight)

examples.en: She has a fear of spiders, so she checks her shoes first.
examples.zh: 她「害怕」蜘蛛，所以总是先检查鞋子。

examples.en: His greatest fear is speaking in front of the whole class.
examples.zh: 他最大的「恐惧」是在全班面前讲话。

words.enDefinition: a single throb of the heart; also a regular pulsing sound or rhythm

examples.en: After the sprint, he could feel every beat of his heart.
examples.zh: 冲刺之后，他能感觉到自己的每一次「心跳」。

examples.en: The steady beat of the drum kept the whole crowd dancing.
examples.zh: 平稳的鼓「点」让全场的人都跳起舞来。

words.enDefinition: choice that is made by counting the number of people in favor of each alternative

examples.en: The committee held a vote on the new opening hours.
examples.zh: 委员会就新的开放时间进行了「表决」。

examples.en: In the last election, more than half the town cast a vote.
examples.zh: 上次选举中，全镇超过半数的人投了「票」。

words.enDefinition: person who invites guests to a social event (such as a party in his or her own home) and who is responsible for them while they are there

examples.en: Our kind host showed us around the garden after dinner.
examples.zh: 饭后，「主人」带我们参观了花园。

examples.en: As host of the barbecue, Dad grilled burgers for hours.
examples.zh: 作为烧烤会的「东道主」，爸爸烤了好几个小时的汉堡。

words.enDefinition: of the colour between black and white

examples.en: The autumn sky turned dark grey before the first storm.
examples.zh: 第一场风暴来临前，秋日的天空变成了「灰色」。

examples.en: She wore a grey coat to match the rainy weather.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件「灰色」大衣来应和多雨的天气。

words.enDefinition: wound resulting from biting by an animal or a person

examples.en: The dog bite needs careful cleaning and a proper bandage.
examples.zh: 狗「咬伤」的伤口需要清洗并好好包扎。

examples.en: She rubbed cream on the insect bites on her ankle.
examples.zh: 她在脚踝上的虫「叮咬」处涂了药膏。

words.enDefinition: impairment resulting from long use

examples.en: The brake pads show signs of wear after two winters.
examples.zh: 经过两个冬天，刹车片已经出现「磨损」迹象。

examples.en: Check the car tyres for wear before the long drive.
examples.zh: 长途出行前检查一下轮胎的「磨损」情况。

words.enDefinition: the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)

examples.en: This was once the site of the old weekly market.
examples.zh: 这里曾是老每周集市所在的「位置」。

examples.en: The construction site next door starts work at seven sharp.
examples.zh: 隔壁的建筑「工地」七点整开工。

words.enDefinition: collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn

examples.en: The survey data shows that most families now shop online.
examples.zh: 调查「数据」显示，如今大多数家庭都在网上购物。

examples.en: Remember to back up your data before reinstalling the system.
examples.zh: 重装系统前记得备份你的「资料」。

words.enDefinition: an individual or group or structure or other entity regarded as a structural or functional constituent of a whole

examples.en: A gram is a basic unit of weight in the metric system.
examples.zh: 克是公制中基本的重量「单位」。

examples.en: Our team moved into a bright new office unit downtown.
examples.zh: 我们团队搬进了市中心一套明亮的新办公「单元」。

words.enDefinition: the specified day of the month

examples.en: What is the date today, the tenth or the eleventh?
examples.zh: 今天是几「号」，十号还是十一号？

examples.en: Mark the exam date on the kitchen calendar in red.
examples.zh: 把考试的「日期」用红笔标在日历上。

words.enDefinition: specific feeling of desire

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a wish before blowing out the candles.
examples.zh: 吹蜡烛前闭上眼睛许个「愿」。

examples.en: Her wish to travel the world came true at forty.
examples.zh: 她「周游世界的愿望」在四十岁时实现了。

words.enDefinition: tall perennial woody plant having a main trunk and branches forming a distinct elevated crown; includes both gymnosperms and angiosperms

examples.en: A tall pine tree shades our picnic table all summer.
examples.zh: 一棵高大的松「树」整个夏天都为我们的野餐桌遮荫。

examples.en: They planted a young apple tree beside the garden gate.
examples.zh: 他们在花园门口种了一棵苹果「树」。

words.enDefinition: male sovereign; ruler of a kingdom

examples.en: The king ruled the small kingdom for thirty peaceful years.
examples.zh: 这位「国王」和平地统治了这个小王国三十年。

examples.en: In the story, the king hides his crown under the bed.
examples.zh: 故事里，「国王」把王冠藏在床底下。

words.enDefinition: titled peer of the realm

examples.en: The old lord of the manor still owns half the valley.
examples.zh: 老「领主」仍然拥有半个山谷的产业。

examples.en: Medieval lords lived in stone castles surrounded by their fields.
examples.zh: 中世纪的「领主」们住在被田地环绕的城堡里。

words.enDefinition: mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services

examples.en: The corner shop sells fresh bread until six every day.
examples.zh: 街角的「商店」每天卖新鲜面包到六点。

examples.en: Grandma runs the village shop and knows everyone's favourite biscuits.
examples.zh: 奶奶经营着村里的「小店」，记得每个人爱吃的饼干。

words.enDefinition: freedom from activity (work or strain or responsibility)

examples.en: After the long drive, we all needed a good rest.
examples.zh: 长途开车之后，我们都需要好好「休息」。

examples.en: The doctor told him to have complete rest for a week.
examples.zh: 医生嘱咐他「静养」一周。

words.enDefinition: the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it

examples.en: Her goal is to run a marathon before she turns thirty.
examples.zh: 她的「目标」是在三十岁前跑完一场马拉松。

examples.en: The team's goal this season is promotion to the top league.
examples.zh: 球队本赛季的「目标」是升入顶级联赛。

words.enDefinition: to put something into a space until it is full; to make something full

examples.en: Fill the kettle and put it on for afternoon tea.
examples.zh: 把水壶「装满」水，烧上泡茶。

examples.en: Please fill in this form and sign at the bottom.
examples.zh: 请「填写」这张表格并在底部签名。

words.enDefinition: shape that is spherical and small

examples.en: A single drop of rain hit the window before the storm.
examples.zh: 暴雨来临前，一「滴」雨点打在了窗户上。

examples.en: Add a drop of lemon juice to brighten the sauce.
examples.zh: 在酱汁里加一「滴」柠檬汁提味。

words.enDefinition: the act of applying force in order to move something away

examples.en: Give the door a gentle push; it sticks in damp weather.
examples.zh: 轻轻「推」一下门，天潮的时候它会卡住。

examples.en: With one strong push, the loaded trolley finally started moving.
examples.zh: 用力一「推」，手推车终于动了起来。

words.enDefinition: the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)

examples.en: What size shoes do you usually wear for winter hiking?
examples.zh: 冬季徒步你通常穿多大「码」的鞋？

examples.en: The enormous size of the garden surprised us all pleasantly.
examples.zh: 花园的「大小」让我们又惊又喜。

words.enDefinition: brief written record

examples.en: Leave a note on the fridge if you go out early.
examples.zh: 如果一早出门，就在冰箱上留张「便条」。

examples.en: She made a careful note of the doctor's phone number.
examples.zh: 她仔细地把医生的电话号码「记」了下来。

words.enDefinition: people who are no longer living

examples.en: The gardener removed the dead branches before the spring growth.
examples.zh: 园丁在春季生长前剪掉了「枯死的」树枝。

examples.en: The car would not start because the battery was completely dead.
examples.zh: 汽车打不着火，因为电瓶彻底「没电」了。

words.enDefinition: pleasant, kind, or attractive

examples.en: It was really nice of you to wait for me after class.
examples.zh: 下课后你等我，真是太「好」了。

examples.en: We had a nice long chat over coffee this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我们边喝咖啡边「愉快地」聊了很久。

words.enDefinition: any small compartment

examples.en: The guide showed us the monk's small cell in the old abbey.
examples.zh: 导游带我们参观了老修道院里修士住的「小房间」。

examples.en: Honeybees build perfect hexagonal cells to store honey and pollen.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂筑起六角形的「蜂巢室」来储存蜂蜜和花粉。

words.enDefinition: polite name for any woman

examples.en: The lady at the bakery gave us an extra roll.
examples.zh: 面包店那位「女士」多给了我们一个小圆面包。

examples.en: A kind lady helped carry the pram up the stairs.
examples.zh: 一位好心的「女士」帮忙把婴儿车抬上了楼梯。

words.enDefinition: The objective case of who. See Who.

examples.en: To whom exactly did you lend the lawnmower last weekend?
examples.zh: 上周末你把割草机借给「谁」了？

examples.en: The author, whom I met at the book fair, signed my copy.
examples.zh: 我在书展上见到的那位作者（whom 指代的「那位作者」）在我的书上签了名。

words.enDefinition: a piece of work that needs to be done

examples.en: Our first task this morning is sorting all the recycling.
examples.zh: 我们今天早上的第一项「任务」是整理回收物。

examples.en: The history teacher assigned a difficult task about local history.
examples.zh: 老师布置了一项关于本地历史的困难「任务」。

words.enDefinition: failure to hit (or meet or find etc)

examples.en: His only miss of the whole match hit the crossbar.
examples.zh: 他全场比赛唯一一次「射失」打在了横梁上。

examples.en: A near miss on the busy motorway left everyone shaken.
examples.zh: 高速上一次「险些相撞」让大家心有余悸。

words.enDefinition: have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined

examples.en: I tend to drink more tea than coffee in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天我「往往」喝的茶比咖啡多。

examples.en: Indoor houseplants tend to grow toward the nearest window light.
examples.zh: 室内植物通常「倾向于」朝最近的窗光生长。

words.enDefinition: short musical composition with words

examples.en: Grandma hums her favourite old song while kneading the dough.
examples.zh: 奶奶揉面时哼着「歌」。

examples.en: This song always reminds me of summer camp by the lake.
examples.zh: 这首「歌」总让我想起湖边的夏令营。

words.enDefinition: large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property

examples.en: The kids spent the whole sunny afternoon in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在「公园」里玩了一整个阳光灿烂的下午。

examples.en: There is a new dog park near the river bridge.
examples.zh: 河桥附近新建了一个遛狗「公园」。

words.enDefinition: absence of light or illumination

examples.en: He is afraid of the dark, so we leave a small lamp on.
examples.zh: 他怕「黑」，所以我们留一盏小灯。

examples.en: The streetlights switched on as the dark settled over the valley.
examples.zh: 「夜幕」笼罩山谷时，路灯亮了起来。

words.enDefinition: the way a garment hangs

examples.en: I really love the soft hang of these linen curtains.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这些亚麻窗帘柔美的「垂坠感」。

examples.en: She adjusted the hang of the scarf in the mirror.
examples.zh: 她对着镜子调整「围巾垂坠的样子」。

words.enDefinition: lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter

examples.en: The kids climbed carefully over the rocks at the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子们在海滩的「岩石」间小心攀爬。

examples.en: A fallen rock blocked the narrow mountain path for hours.
examples.zh: 一块落下的「岩石」把山路堵了好几个小时。

words.enDefinition: mild viral infection involving the nose and respiratory passages (but not the lungs)

examples.en: I caught a heavy cold at the start of winter.
examples.zh: 入冬时我得了重「感冒」。

examples.en: Hot lemon tea always helps when you have a cold.
examples.zh: 「感冒」时喝热柠檬茶总是有用。

words.enDefinition: one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes

examples.en: Send Granny a birthday card this year by real post.
examples.zh: 今年用真正的邮寄给奶奶寄一张生日「贺卡」。

examples.en: He paid quickly by card at the multistorey car park.
examples.zh: 他在多层停车场用「银行卡」付款。

words.enDefinition: space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)

examples.en: Is this seat taken, or may I sit down here?
examples.zh: 这个「座位」有人吗，我可以坐这里吗？

examples.en: Please return to your seat before the plane takes off.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞前请回到「座位」上。

words.enDefinition: unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope

examples.en: The huge waves kept all the small boats in harbour.
examples.zh: 「极大的」海浪把所有小船都留在了港里。

examples.en: Cleaning the huge stadium after the concert took two days.
examples.zh: 清理「巨大的」体育场花了两天时间。

words.enDefinition: round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games

examples.en: The dog chased the ball right into the neighbour's yard.
examples.zh: 狗追着「球」一直跑进邻居的院子。

examples.en: We kicked the ball around in the yard after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们在院子里踢「球」。

words.enDefinition: symptom of some physical hurt or disorder

examples.en: A sharp pain in his shoulder sent him to the doctor.
examples.zh: 肩膀的剧「痛」让他去看了医生。

examples.en: The medicine eased the pain in her knee within an hour.
examples.zh: 一小时内，药物就缓解了她膝盖的「疼痛」。

words.enDefinition: any of various mostly cold-blooded aquatic vertebrates usually having scales and breathing through gills

examples.en: He luckily caught three fat fish before breakfast this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早饭前他钓到了三条肥「鱼」。

examples.en: The village pond is stocked with young fish every spring.
examples.zh: 池塘每年春天都会投放「鱼苗」。

words.enDefinition: distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list

examples.en: Add this item to the list before we forget it.
examples.zh: 趁还没忘，把这一「项」加到清单上。

examples.en: Every single item on the menu costs under ten dollars.
examples.zh: 菜单上每一「样」都不超过十美元。

words.enDefinition: journey for some purpose (usually including the return)

examples.en: Our trip to the mountains was cancelled because of snow.
examples.zh: 因为下雪，我们去山里的「旅行」取消了。

examples.en: The little ferry trip across the bay takes forty minutes.
examples.zh: 乘渡轮横渡海湾的「行程」要四十分钟。

words.enDefinition: extending far down or far in; very intense or strong

examples.en: The old well is surprisingly deep, so cover it properly.
examples.zh: 那口老井「深」得出奇，务必盖好。

examples.en: She took a deep breath before walking onto the stage.
examples.zh: 上台之前，她「深」吸了一口气。

words.enDefinition: the boundary of a surface

examples.en: Do not lean over the edge of the station platform.
examples.zh: 不要探身到站台的「边缘」外。

examples.en: The cat sat at the edge of the sofa, watching the fish tank.
examples.zh: 猫坐在沙发「边」上盯着鱼缸。

words.enDefinition: form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature

examples.en: The fierce midday heat drove everyone indoors before eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 正午的「暑热」让所有人十一点前就躲进了屋内。

examples.en: You can feel the heat rising from the city pavement.
examples.zh: 你能感觉到城市路面蒸腾的「热气」。

words.enDefinition: deliver by singing

examples.en: She loves to sing loudly in the shower before school.
examples.zh: 她喜欢上学前在淋浴时「唱歌」。

examples.en: The choir will sing at the town festival on Saturday.
examples.zh: 合唱团周六将在镇艺术节上「演唱」。

words.enDefinition: the outer covering of the body of a person or animal

examples.en: After a week at the beach, my skin went brown.
examples.zh: 在海边待了一周，我的「皮肤」晒成了棕色。

examples.en: The green lizard sheds its skin several times a year.
examples.zh: 蜥蜴每年会「蜕皮」好几次。

words.enDefinition: strongbox where valuables can be safely kept

examples.en: Keep the passports and tickets in the hotel safe overnight.
examples.zh: 把护照和票放在酒店的「保险箱」里过夜。

examples.en: The old iron safe in the basement still locks perfectly.
examples.zh: 地下室那台旧「保险柜」仍然锁得牢牢的。

words.enDefinition: warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings

examples.en: A brightly coloured little bird visited our feeder this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上一只色彩鲜艳的「鸟」光顾了我们的喂食器。

examples.en: Tired migrating birds rest in the reeds beside the lake.
examples.zh: 迁徙的「鸟」在湖边的芦苇丛里歇脚。

words.enDefinition: possessing material wealth

examples.en: He grew up very rich but chose to live simply.
examples.zh: 他从小生活「富裕」，却选择了简朴的生活。

examples.en: The region is rich in history and old timber houses.
examples.zh: 这个地区历史底蕴「深厚」，还有很多老木屋。

words.enDefinition: not at all; in no degree (used to strengthen a negative, as in 'none too pleased')

examples.en: The written reply was none too polite, to be honest.
examples.zh: 说实话，那份答复「一点也不」客气。

examples.en: The water in the village well is none too clean.
examples.zh: 村里井水的水质「并不」干净。

words.enDefinition: air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure

examples.en: Close the window; the cold wind is picking up quickly.
examples.zh: 关上窗户，「风」正迅速变大。

examples.en: The strong wind blew the washing clean off the line.
examples.zh: 「风」把晾的衣物全从绳上吹落了。

words.enDefinition: moving or able to move quickly; happening without delay

examples.en: The fast train reaches the coast in under two hours.
examples.zh: 「快」车不到两小时就到海边。

examples.en: That mountain river runs really fast after the spring thaw.
examples.zh: 春融之后，那条河流「湍急」。

words.enDefinition: the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable

examples.en: The plants died from a lack of water in July.
examples.zh: 七月「缺水」，植物都枯死了。

examples.en: A simple lack of sleep made the whole team cranky.
examples.zh: 「睡眠不足」让全队都烦躁不安。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which the revenue of a business exceeds its cost of operating

examples.en: The doctor noted his weight gain after months of late-night snacks.
examples.zh: 医生记下了他几个月吃宵夜带来的体重「增加」。

examples.en: There has been a real gain in her confidence this term.
examples.zh: 这学期她的自信心有了实实在在的「增长」。

words.enDefinition: an animal that produces gametes (spermatozoa) that can fertilize female gametes (ova)

examples.en: In many bird species, the male bird has brighter feathers.
examples.zh: 在许多鸟类中，「雄性」的羽毛更鲜艳。

examples.en: The young vet said the kitten is a healthy male.
examples.zh: 兽医说这只小猫是只健康的「公猫」。

words.enDefinition: physical pain or emotional distress

examples.en: Her kind words eased the hurt left by the argument.
examples.zh: 暖心的话语减轻了争吵留下的「伤害」。

examples.en: Time slowly softened the hurt of losing the old house.
examples.zh: 时间冲淡了失去老房子的「伤痛」。

words.enDefinition: instrumentalists not including string players

examples.en: The school band practises in the big hall every Thursday.
examples.zh: 学校「乐队」每周四在大厅排练。

examples.en: A lively jazz band played at the wedding until midnight.
examples.zh: 一支爵士「乐队」在婚礼上一直演奏到午夜。

words.enDefinition: gathering of producers to promote business

examples.en: We bought lovely handmade soap at the spring craft fair.
examples.zh: 我们在春季手工艺「博览会」上买了手工皂。

examples.en: The book fair fills the whole town hall each October.
examples.zh: 每年十月，图书「交易会」占满了整个市政厅。

words.enDefinition: workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit

examples.en: We bought fresh eggs from the farm down the road.
examples.zh: 我们从路那头的「农场」买了新鲜鸡蛋。

examples.en: Grandpa worked on a big dairy farm in his youth.
examples.zh: 爷爷年轻时在「奶牛场」干活。

words.enDefinition: set of related records (either written or electronic) kept together

examples.en: The young lawyer pulled the client's file from the cabinet.
examples.zh: 律师从柜子里抽出客户的「档案」。

examples.en: Every written complaint is kept on file for five years.
examples.zh: 每份投诉都会「存档」五年。

words.enDefinition: thing made to be similar or identical to another thing

examples.en: Keep a copy of the contract in your desk drawer.
examples.zh: 在书桌抽屉里留一份合同「副本」。

examples.en: This painting is a copy; the original hangs in Madrid.
examples.zh: 这幅画是「复制品」，真迹挂在马德里。

words.enDefinition: temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers

examples.en: The young scouts pitched their camp beside the river bend.
examples.zh: 童子军们在河湾边扎起了「营地」。

examples.en: The mountain camp sits at two thousand metres beside a stream.
examples.zh: 山上的「营地」设在海拔两千米的一条小溪旁。

words.enDefinition: money in the form of bills or coins

examples.en: The busy Saturday market stall takes cash only, no cards.
examples.zh: 周六市场摊位只收「现金」，不刷卡。

examples.en: I always keep some cash aside for the bus fare.
examples.zh: 我总是备一些「现金」付车费。

words.enDefinition: an opening into or through something

examples.en: The mouse vanished into a hole behind the skirting board.
examples.zh: 老鼠钻进踢脚板后面的一个「洞」里不见了。

examples.en: There is a hole in the toe of my left sock.
examples.zh: 我左脚袜子的脚尖处有个「洞」。

words.enDefinition: set of two similar things considered as a unit

examples.en: I bought a new pair of running shoes on sale.
examples.zh: 打折时我买了一「双」新跑鞋。

examples.en: This warm new pair of gloves matches the scarf perfectly.
examples.zh: 这「一副」暖和的手套和围巾非常相配。

words.enDefinition: vessel that carries passengers or freight

examples.en: The huge cargo ship left port with the morning tide.
examples.zh: 货「船」趁着早潮离开了港口。

examples.en: A century ago, emigrants crossed the ocean on crowded ships.
examples.zh: 一个世纪前，移民们乘坐拥挤的「轮船」横渡大洋。

words.enDefinition: a small round mark or dirty patch on a surface

examples.en: A dark spot of gravy landed on the clean tablecloth.
examples.zh: 一滴深色「污渍」落在了干净的桌布上。

examples.en: Dark grease spots from the bicycle chain stained his trousers.
examples.zh: 自行车链条的油「渍」弄脏了他的裤子。

words.enDefinition: small vessel for travel on water

examples.en: We rented a small boat and rowed across the lake.
examples.zh: 我们租了一条小「船」，划到湖对岸。

examples.en: The little fishing boat returns to the harbour at dusk.
examples.zh: 渔「船」黄昏时分回到港口。

words.enDefinition: the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees

examples.en: The heavy old table is made of solid oak wood.
examples.zh: 这张旧桌子由坚实的橡「木」制成。

examples.en: Stack the split wood by the shed so it stays dry.
examples.zh: 把劈好的「木柴」堆在小屋旁，保持干燥。

words.enDefinition: list of names

examples.en: The teacher called the roll at the start of class.
examples.zh: 上课开始时老师照「名册」点了名。

examples.en: His name now stands first on the club's membership roll.
examples.zh: 他的名字现在排在俱乐部「名册」的第一位。

words.enDefinition: number or letter indicating quality (especially of a student's performance)

examples.en: She lost two marks just for spelling the title wrong.
examples.zh: 她因把标题拼错被「扣了两分」。

examples.en: He earned the highest mark in the class this term.
examples.zh: 这学期他拿了全班最高的「分数」。

words.enDefinition: coins made of gold

examples.en: The early miners panned for gold in this mountain river.
examples.zh: 早期矿工在这条山间河里淘「金」。

examples.en: The champion's medal is only gold-plated rather than solid gold.
examples.zh: 冠军奖牌是镀「金」的，并非纯金。

words.enDefinition: declare untrue; contradict

examples.en: He denied breaking the window, but his muddy shoes said otherwise.
examples.zh: 他「否认」打碎了窗户，但满是泥的鞋子出卖了他。

examples.en: The company denies any safety problems at the old plant.
examples.zh: 公司「否认」老工厂存在任何安全问题。

words.enDefinition: the means of connection between things linked in series

examples.en: Doctors found a clear link between diet and sleep quality.
examples.zh: 医生发现饮食和睡眠质量之间有明确的「联系」。

examples.en: Click the link at the bottom of the email to register.
examples.zh: 点击邮件底部的「链接」即可报名。

words.enDefinition: mechanical device that you ride for amusement or excitement

examples.en: The roller coaster is the most popular ride in the park.
examples.zh: 过山车是乐园里最受欢迎的「游乐设施」。

examples.en: The little ones loved the miniature train ride at the zoo.
examples.zh: 小朋友们喜欢动物园里环绕全园的小火车「游乐项目」。

words.enDefinition: wild primitive state untouched by civilization

examples.en: Grey wolves still live in the wild in these mountains.
examples.zh: 这些山里仍有狼生活在「荒野」中。

examples.en: The garden was left to grow wild behind the shed.
examples.zh: 小屋后面的花园任其「荒芜」。

words.enDefinition: fermented juice (of grapes especially)

examples.en: Uncle brought a bottle of red wine for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 叔叔带了一瓶红「葡萄酒」来吃周日晚餐。

examples.en: This sunny valley is famous for its crisp white wine.
examples.zh: 这个山谷以清爽的白「葡萄酒」闻名。

words.enDefinition: acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions

examples.en: She earns some extra money by tutoring maths at weekends.
examples.zh: 她周末辅导数学「赚」外快。

examples.en: He earned the team's respect by never missing a practice.
examples.zh: 他从不缺训，因而「赢得」了全队的尊重。

words.enDefinition: food for domestic livestock

examples.en: The farmer stored the winter feed in the tall barn.
examples.zh: 农民把过冬的「饲料」存进高高的谷仓。

examples.en: The price of chicken feed rose sharply again this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天鸡「饲料」价格又涨了。

words.enDefinition: an act of raising something to a higher position

examples.en: The movers gave the piano one heavy lift up the stairs.
examples.zh: 搬运工们用力一「抬」，把钢琴搬上了楼。

examples.en: The crane completed the delicate lift in under a minute.
examples.zh: 吊车不到一分钟就完成了这次精细的「起吊」。

words.enDefinition: the act of pushing off the ground and rising into the air; a leap

examples.en: The young horse cleared the highest jump of the course.
examples.zh: 马儿越过了全程最高的「跳跃障碍」。

examples.en: With one running jump, he cleared the narrow garden stream.
examples.zh: 他助跑一「跳」，跃过了花园的小溪。

words.enDefinition: having or giving out heat to a moderate degree; friendly

examples.en: The bread came out of the oven warm and golden.
examples.zh: 面包出炉时又「暖」又金黄。

examples.en: Our new neighbours gave us a genuinely warm welcome here.
examples.zh: 新邻居给了我们真心实意的「热情」欢迎。

words.enDefinition: on the positive side or higher end of a scale

examples.en: Two plus two makes four, as every child learns early.
examples.zh: 二「加」二等于四，每个孩子早早就会学。

examples.en: The rent is six hundred a month, plus the utility bills.
examples.zh: 房租每月六百，「外加」水电账单。

words.enDefinition: yielding readily to pressure or weight

examples.en: The white cat's fur is incredibly soft after her bath.
examples.zh: 猫咪洗完澡后，毛摸起来「软」极了。

examples.en: He speaks in a soft voice that calms the toddlers.
examples.zh: 他说话声音「轻柔」，能安抚学步的孩子。

words.enDefinition: one of a series of ridges that moves across the surface of a liquid (especially across a large body of water)

examples.en: A big wave knocked over the whole sandcastle in seconds.
examples.zh: 一个大「浪」几秒钟就把沙堡打翻了。

examples.en: Waves lapped gently against the side of the rowing boat.
examples.zh: 「海浪」轻轻拍打着划艇的船舷。

words.enDefinition: set of garments (usually including a jacket and trousers or skirt) for outerwear all of the same fabric and color

examples.en: He wears a smart grey suit to every client meeting.
examples.zh: 他每次见客户都穿灰色「西装」。

examples.en: This suit needs dry cleaning before the interview on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五面试前，这套「西装」需要干洗。

words.enDefinition: someone who cooks food

examples.en: The cook at our canteen makes the best dumplings in town.
examples.zh: 我们食堂的「厨师」做的饺子全镇最好。

examples.en: Grandma was the family cook for more than fifty years.
examples.zh: 奶奶当了五十多年的家庭「厨师」。

words.enDefinition: journey or route all the way around a particular place or area

examples.en: The free city tour ends at the old harbour market.
examples.zh: 城市「观光」行程在老港口市场结束。

examples.en: We joined a guided tour of the castle's hidden rooms.
examples.zh: 我们参加了城堡隐藏房间的导览「游览」。

words.enDefinition: pain that feels hot as if it were on fire

examples.en: Cool the fresh burn under running water for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把「烧伤」处放在流动水下冲十分钟降温。

examples.en: The cook got a painful burn from the oven tray.
examples.zh: 厨师被烤箱烤盘烫出了一种「灼痛」。

words.enDefinition: level tract of land

examples.en: The route home is flat, so the ride is easy.
examples.zh: 回家的路线很「平坦」，骑车很轻松。

examples.en: Lay the map flat on the table to see the whole region.
examples.zh: 把地图「平铺」在桌上，才能看到整个区域。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being at a refreshingly low temperature

examples.en: We enjoyed the cool of the evening on the porch.
examples.zh: 我们在门廊上享受夜晚的「凉爽」。

examples.en: The stone basement keeps its cool even in hot August.
examples.zh: 即使在八月，石头地下室也保持着「凉意」。

words.enDefinition: long thin piece of cloth or paper as used for binding or fastening

examples.en: Use strong brown tape to seal the moving boxes properly.
examples.zh: 用结实的「胶带」把搬家纸箱封好。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps a box of old cassette tapes in the attic.
examples.zh: 爷爷的阁楼里有一箱旧盒式「磁带」。

words.enDefinition: water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere

examples.en: The first real rain finally arrived after six dry weeks.
examples.zh: 干早六周之后，第一场像样的「雨」终于来了。

examples.en: Heavy overnight rain flooded the lane outside the school gates.
examples.zh: 大「雨」淹了校门外的巷道。

words.enDefinition: notify of danger, potential harm, or risk

examples.en: The red signs warn swimmers about the strong underwater current.
examples.zh: 标牌「警告」游泳者水下水流湍急。

examples.en: Doctors always warn their patients about this medicine's side effects.
examples.zh: 医生总会「提醒」病人注意这种药的副作用。

words.enDefinition: substance that can be consumed to produce energy

examples.en: Check the fuel gauge before starting the long drive home.
examples.zh: 出发长途回家前先检查「燃料」。

examples.en: Rising fuel prices affect every small delivery company in town.
examples.zh: 「燃油」涨价影响着镇上每一家货运公司。

words.enDefinition: piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments

examples.en: My desk faces the window, so I watch the birds while working.
examples.zh: 我的「书桌」朝着窗户，工作时能看到鸟。

examples.en: Please clear your desk completely before the cleaning staff arrive.
examples.zh: 保洁人员来之前请清理好你的「书桌」。

words.enDefinition: become slow or slower

examples.en: Traffic is slow near the school at half past three.
examples.zh: 下午三点半学校附近车流「缓慢」。

examples.en: She took a slow walk around the garden after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后她在花园里「缓缓地」散步。

words.enDefinition: movable organ for flying (one of a pair)

examples.en: The bird hurt its wing and cannot fly for now.
examples.zh: 这只鸟伤了「翅膀」，暂时不能飞。

examples.en: A butterfly's wing is covered with thousands of tiny scales.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的「翅膀」上覆盖着成千上万片细小的鳞片。

words.enDefinition: the motion characteristic of fluids (liquids or gases)

examples.en: The flow of the river slows near the old bridge.
examples.zh: 河水在老桥附近的「流动」变缓。

examples.en: Traffic flow improved greatly after the new lane opened downtown.
examples.zh: 市中心新车道开通后，交通「流量」顺畅了。

words.enDefinition: minor inadvertent mistake usually observed in speech or writing or in small accidents or memory lapses etc.

examples.en: She had a nasty slip on the icy garden path.
examples.zh: 她在结冰的花园小径上重重「滑了一跤」。

examples.en: A slip of the tongue caused the whole class to laugh.
examples.zh: 一次「口误」惹得全班大笑。

words.enDefinition: the act of delivering a blow with the foot

examples.en: He gave the ball a powerful kick toward the top corner.
examples.zh: 他用力一「踢」，把球踢向球门上角。

examples.en: The startled horse's kick knocked the water bucket right over.
examples.zh: 马「踢」了一脚，把水桶踢翻了。

words.enDefinition: a shapeless lump or collection of matter; a large quantity

examples.en: A dark mass of storm clouds gathered on the horizon.
examples.zh: 地平线上聚起一大「团」乌云。

examples.en: Masses of slimy seaweed washed up after the weekend storm.
examples.zh: 周末风暴后，大「团」大「团」的海藻被冲上岸。

words.enDefinition: small hard fruit

examples.en: Plant the tomato seeds two centimetres deep in small pots.
examples.zh: 把番茄「种子」种进小花盆两厘米深。

examples.en: This apple has dark seeds, so it is fully ripe.
examples.zh: 这个苹果的「籽」是深色的，说明完全熟了。

words.enDefinition: prescribed selection of foods

examples.en: A balanced daily diet matters more than any single superfood.
examples.zh: 均衡的「日常饮食」比任何单一超级食物都重要。

examples.en: The doctor suggested a low-salt diet for Grandpa's blood pressure.
examples.zh: 医生建议爷爷为控制血压采用低盐「饮食」。

words.enDefinition: an explosive device fused to explode under specific conditions

examples.en: Workers found an old wartime bomb during the subway dig.
examples.zh: 工人在地铁施工时发现了一枚战争年代的旧「炸弹」。

examples.en: Bomb experts safely removed the defused bomb from the site.
examples.zh: 专家安全地移走了已拆除引信的「炸弹」。

words.enDefinition: the actors in a play

examples.en: The whole cast bowed together at the end of the play.
examples.zh: 剧终时，「全体演员」一起鞠躬谢幕。

examples.en: The cast celebrated opening night backstage with pizza and music.
examples.zh: 「剧组」全体成员在后台用披萨和音乐庆祝首演之夜。

words.enDefinition: person responsible for hiring workers

examples.en: My kind boss finally approved the holiday request this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上「老板」终于批准了我的休假申请。

examples.en: The friendly boss of the bakery knows every regular's order.
examples.zh: 面包店的「老板」记得每位熟客的订单。

words.enDefinition: an instinctive motive

examples.en: I resisted the urge to check my phone during dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭时我忍住了看手机的「冲动」。

examples.en: He felt a sudden urge to laugh during the solemn speech.
examples.zh: 严肃的演讲途中，他突然「很想」笑。

words.enDefinition: complete collection of similar things

examples.en: She grabbed a pack of biscuits on her way out.
examples.zh: 出门时她顺手抓了一「包」饼干。

examples.en: The whole pack of playing cards is missing two aces.
examples.zh: 这「一副」牌少了两张A。

words.enDefinition: friendly nation

examples.en: In the group project, my cousin was my strongest ally.
examples.zh: 小组作业里，表哥是我最坚定的「盟友」。

examples.en: The two small shops became allies against the supermarket chain.
examples.zh: 两家小店联合起来，成了对抗连锁超市的「盟友」。

words.enDefinition: the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle

examples.en: My aunt sends us a jar of homemade jam every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，我「姑姑」都会寄来一罐自制果酱。

examples.en: Aunt Rosa patiently taught me to make pasta by hand.
examples.zh: 「罗莎姨妈」教我手工做意大利面。

words.enDefinition: large room for gatherings or entertainment

examples.en: The wedding reception will be held in the village hall.
examples.zh: 婚宴在村里的「礼堂」举行。

examples.en: The brand new concert hall seats five hundred people comfortably.
examples.zh: 新音乐「厅」能舒适地容纳五百人。

words.enDefinition: person who makes use of a thing; someone who uses or employs something

examples.en: The gym asks every user to wipe down the equipment.
examples.zh: 健身房要求每位「使用者」擦拭器材。

examples.en: This free design software now has a million registered users.
examples.zh: 这款免费软件如今有一百万注册「用户」。

words.enDefinition: On the top of; upon; on. See On to, under On, prep.

examples.en: The naughty cat jumped onto the warm laptop keyboard again.
examples.zh: 猫又跳「到」了温热的笔记本电脑键盘上。

examples.en: He stepped nervously onto the stage to collect his prize.
examples.zh: 他走「上」舞台去领奖。

words.enDefinition: the words of something written

examples.en: Read the short text on the museum plaque out loud.
examples.zh: 把博物馆铭牌上的「文字」大声读出来。

examples.en: I highlighted one very important line in the history text.
examples.zh: 我在历史「课文」里高亮了一句重要的话。

words.enDefinition: local and well-defined elevation of the land

examples.en: Our house sits on the hill, so the view is wonderful.
examples.zh: 我们家坐落在小「山」上，视野绝佳。

examples.en: Cycling up the steep hill behind the village takes real effort.
examples.zh: 骑车上村后的陡「坡」确实费劲。

words.enDefinition: the dressed skin of an animal (especially a large animal)

examples.en: The old tannery prepared each hide for the leather workshop.
examples.zh: 制革厂为皮革作坊处理每一张「兽皮」。

examples.en: The old family sofa is upholstered in thick cow hide.
examples.zh: 这张旧沙发用厚实的牛「皮」包面。

words.enDefinition: way especially designed for a particular use

examples.en: The old stone path leads straight down to the beach.
examples.zh: 这条石「路」一直通到海滩。

examples.en: Keep to the marked path while walking in the reserve.
examples.zh: 在保护区内请沿标记的「小路」行走。

words.enDefinition: and nothing more

examples.en: The app is merely a tool; your practice does the work.
examples.zh: 这个应用「只是」工具，真正的功夫在于你的练习。

examples.en: He merely shrugged when we asked about the broken vase.
examples.zh: 我们问起打碎的花瓶时，他「只是」耸了耸肩。

words.enDefinition: an implement used in the practice of a vocation

examples.en: The right tool makes every home repair twice as easy.
examples.zh: 合适的「工具」能让每次修理事半功倍。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps each small tool in a labelled wooden box.
examples.zh: 爷爷把每件「工具」都放在贴了标签的木盒里。

words.enDefinition: characteristic sound

examples.en: Grandma's gold ring has a tiny ruby in the centre.
examples.zh: 奶奶的金「戒指」中央镶着一颗小红宝石。

examples.en: He slipped the engagement ring onto her finger at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分，他把订婚「戒指」戴上了她的手指。

words.enDefinition: something acquired without compensation

examples.en: The handmade wool scarf was a gift from my aunt.
examples.zh: 这条手工围巾是「姑姑」送的「礼物」。

examples.en: The best gift you can give a new parent is sleep.
examples.zh: 你能送给新手父母最好的「礼物」是睡眠。

words.enDefinition: something that remunerates

examples.en: The bakery raised its hourly wage at the start of the month.
examples.zh: 面包店月初上调了每小时的「工资」。

examples.en: He saves part of every wage for his evening classes.
examples.zh: 他从每份「工资」里存一部分付夜校学费。

words.enDefinition: powerful stroke with the fist or a weapon

examples.en: The boxer took a heavy blow to the shoulder in round two.
examples.zh: 第二回合，拳击手肩膀上重重挨了一「击」。

examples.en: Losing the grant came as a cruel blow to the team.
examples.zh: 补助金落空对团队是残酷的「打击」。

words.enDefinition: the food served and eaten at one time

examples.en: Breakfast is still the most important meal of the day.
examples.zh: 早餐是一天中最重要的一「餐」。

examples.en: They shared a quiet birthday meal at the corner cafe.
examples.zh: 他们在街角咖啡馆安静地吃了一顿「饭」。

words.enDefinition: footwear shaped to fit the foot (below the ankle) with a flexible upper of leather or plastic and a sole and heel of heavier material

examples.en: There is a deep scuff on my new shoe already.
examples.zh: 我的新「鞋」上已经有了一道磨痕。

examples.en: Please take off your shoes and leave them by the door.
examples.zh: 请脱「鞋」放在门边。

words.enDefinition: rigid connective tissue that makes up the skeleton of vertebrates

examples.en: The dog buried a large bone in the garden yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天狗在花园里埋了一根「骨头」。

examples.en: Grandma's rich broth simmers with a marrow bone all morning.
examples.zh: 奶奶的汤用一根髓「骨」炖了一上午。

words.enDefinition: any place of pain and turmoil;

examples.en: The rescuers described the flooded mine as a living hell.
examples.zh: 救援者形容被淹的矿井如同「地狱」。

examples.en: Grandpa always said the war memories were his private hell.
examples.zh: 爷爷常说战争记忆是他的私人「地狱」。

words.enDefinition: set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones)

examples.en: The school has a strict dress code for the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典礼上学校有严格的着装「规定」。

examples.en: The medieval knights lived by a strict code of honour.
examples.zh: 中世纪骑士遵循严格的「荣誉准则」。

words.enDefinition: a sudden attempt to take hold of something

examples.en: She made a grab for the last biscuit and missed.
examples.zh: 她伸手一「抓」最后一块饼干，没抓到。

examples.en: His sudden grab for the falling cup saved the tablecloth.
examples.zh: 他猛地一「抓」，接住了掉落的杯子，保住了桌布。

words.enDefinition: hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella

examples.en: She scraped her knee when she fell off the scooter.
examples.zh: 她从滑板车上摔下来擦伤了「膝盖」。

examples.en: Always bend your knees properly before lifting the heavy box.
examples.zh: 搬重箱子前要先正确地「屈膝」。

words.enDefinition: the act of paying to use something for a limited time

examples.en: Car hire is cheaper if you book online in advance.
examples.zh: 提前网上预订，汽车「租赁」更便宜。

examples.en: The rowing boat is available for hire at the jetty.
examples.zh: 那条划艇可以在码头「租用」。

words.enDefinition: be subject to change in accordance with a variable

examples.en: Prices vary a lot from one market stall to the next.
examples.zh: 各市场摊位的价格「各不相同」。

examples.en: The daily menu varies with whatever the fishermen bring in.
examples.zh: 菜单随渔民每次的渔获而「变化」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a piece of meat that contains little fat

examples.en: Ask the butcher for a piece of lean beef for the stew.
examples.zh: 让肉铺师傅为炖菜挑一块「瘦肉」。

examples.en: This cut of pork has far more lean than fat.
examples.zh: 这块猪肉「瘦」的部分远多于肥的。

words.enDefinition: the part of an organism (human or animal) that connects the head to the rest of the body

examples.en: Wear a scarf to keep your neck warm on the bike.
examples.zh: 骑车时戴条围巾给「脖子」保暖。

examples.en: The itchy label scratched the back of his neck all day.
examples.zh: 扎人的标签蹭得他后「颈」发痒。

words.enDefinition: garment size for a tall person

examples.en: The very tall boy in the back row plays centre.
examples.zh: 后排那个「高个子」男孩打中锋。

examples.en: Our sunflowers grow surprisingly tall in the light sandy soil.
examples.zh: 在我们松软的沙土里，向日葵长得出奇地「高」。

words.enDefinition: the emotion of intense dislike; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action

examples.en: There was no hate in her honest criticism, only concern.
examples.zh: 她的批评里没有「憎恨」，只有关心。

examples.en: The old song describes how hate slowly turns into forgiveness.
examples.zh: 这首歌讲述「恨」如何慢慢化为原谅。
