words.enDefinition: the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants

examples.en: Every single leaf on the maple turned red in October.
examples.zh: 十月里，枫树的每片「叶子」都红了。

examples.en: A dry brown leaf drifted down onto her open notebook.
examples.zh: 一片枯黄的「落叶」飘到她摊开的笔记本上。

words.enDefinition: an excavation that is (usually) filled with water

examples.en: The heated hotel swimming pool opens at seven every morning.
examples.zh: 酒店「泳池」每天早上七点开放。

examples.en: Children splashed happily in the shallow pool near the fountain.
examples.zh: 孩子们在喷泉边的浅「水池」里开心地戏水。

words.enDefinition: compound formed by replacing hydrogen in an acid by a metal (or a radical that acts like a metal)

examples.en: Add a good pinch of salt to the pasta water.
examples.zh: 往煮意面的水里加一撮「盐」。

examples.en: Sea salt tastes much stronger than table salt in dressings.
examples.zh: 在调料汁里，海「盐」比精盐味道更浓。

words.enDefinition: any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning litmus red and reacting with a base to form a salt

examples.en: Fresh lemon juice contains a weak but useful natural acid.
examples.zh: 柠檬汁含有一种弱但实用的天然「酸」。

examples.en: The chemistry teacher showed the class how acid reacts with chalk.
examples.zh: 化学老师演示了「酸」如何与粉笔反应。

words.enDefinition: the immaterial part of a person; the actuating cause of an individual life

examples.en: Grandma always says that truly good music feeds the soul.
examples.zh: 奶奶总说，好的音乐滋养「灵魂」。

examples.en: She put her whole soul into that huge landscape painting.
examples.zh: 她把整个「灵魂」都投入了这幅风景画。

words.enDefinition: lose thickness; become thin or thinner

examples.en: The early ice on the pond is still dangerously thin.
examples.zh: 池塘的冰还很「薄」，非常危险。

examples.en: Cut the cucumber into very thin slices for the salad.
examples.zh: 把黄瓜切成「薄」片做沙拉。

words.enDefinition: movable barrier in a fence or wall

examples.en: Please close the garden gate so the dog stays inside.
examples.zh: 关上花园「大门」，别让狗跑出去。

examples.en: Passengers for the noon flight board today at gate twelve.
examples.zh: 中午航班今天在十二「号登机口」登机。

words.enDefinition: (botany) the usually underground organ that lacks buds or leaves or nodes; absorbs water and mineral salts; usually it anchors the plant to the ground

examples.en: The old tree's roots lift the garden path each winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，老树的「根」都会把花园小径拱起。

examples.en: A knob of ginger root adds warmth to the winter soup.
examples.zh: 加一小块姜「根」能给冬季的汤增加暖意。

words.enDefinition: the organ of smell and entrance to the respiratory tract; the prominent part of the face of man or other mammals

examples.en: The friendly dog pushed its wet nose against my hand.
examples.zh: 狗用湿湿的「鼻子」蹭我的手。

examples.en: Please blow your runny nose properly before the concert begins.
examples.zh: 音乐会开始前请把「鼻涕」擤干净。

words.enDefinition: people who are sick

examples.en: The local charity sends volunteers to care for the sick.
examples.zh: 慈善机构派出志愿者照料「病人」。

examples.en: Sea air was once thought to help the sick recover.
examples.zh: 从前人们认为海边的空气能帮助「病人」康复。

words.enDefinition: occupied with work or another activity, with little time available

examples.en: Mum is busy preparing dinner, so set the table yourself.
examples.zh: 妈妈正「忙着」准备晚饭，你自己摆餐具吧。

examples.en: He is too busy to join us this weekend, sadly.
examples.zh: 可惜他这周末太「忙」，没法和我们一起。

words.enDefinition: narrow way or road

examples.en: The delivery van only barely fits down our narrow lane.
examples.zh: 送货面包车勉强能开进我们那条窄「巷」。

examples.en: A new painted cycle lane runs along the canal path.
examples.zh: 运河步道旁新辟了一条自行车「道」。

words.enDefinition: fossil fuel consisting of carbonized vegetable matter deposited in the Carboniferous period

examples.en: The old black steam locomotive still burns coal for power.
examples.zh: 老式蒸汽机车仍靠烧「煤」获得动力。

examples.en: Grandpa once worked in a coal mine near the valley.
examples.zh: 爷爷曾在山谷附近的「煤矿」工作。

words.enDefinition: locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features

examples.en: Parking is completely free in this zone after six o'clock.
examples.zh: 六点以后在这个「区域」停车免费。

examples.en: The map clearly marks a quiet zone around the library.
examples.zh: 地图上标出了图书馆周围的安静「地带」。

words.enDefinition: to stop sleeping, or to cause someone to stop sleeping

examples.en: Please wake me at six so I do not miss the train.
examples.zh: 请六点「叫醒」我，免得我错过火车。

examples.en: I usually wake naturally before the alarm on working days.
examples.zh: 工作日我通常在闹钟响之前就「醒」了。

words.enDefinition: to deal successfully with a difficult situation or problem

examples.en: She copes with exam stress by running along the river.
examples.zh: 她靠沿河跑步来「应付」压力。

examples.en: How do you cope with three deadlines in one week?
examples.zh: 一周三个截止日期，你是怎么「应对」的？

words.enDefinition: precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals

examples.en: The first proper snow of this winter season arrived overnight.
examples.zh: 入冬后第一场像样的「雪」一夜之间来了。

examples.en: Heavy snow closed the mountain road for two whole days.
examples.zh: 大「雪」把山路整整封了两天。

words.enDefinition: the part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock

examples.en: This heavy clay soil holds water for days after rain.
examples.zh: 这种黏「土」雨后能保水好几天。

examples.en: Turn the garden soil over before planting the spring tulips.
examples.zh: 种春季郁金香前先「翻土」。

words.enDefinition: body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land

examples.en: We swam across the lake early on a calm morning.
examples.zh: 一个无风的清晨，我们游过了「湖」。

examples.en: The mountain lake freezes over most years in late January.
examples.zh: 这个「湖」大多数年份在一月下旬结冰。

words.enDefinition: the quality of a person's voice

examples.en: Her gentle tone softened the moment she saw the baby.
examples.zh: 一看到婴儿，她的「语气」就柔和了下来。

examples.en: The cello's rich deep tone filled the small stone hall.
examples.zh: 大提琴低沉的「音调」充满了小石厅。

words.enDefinition: round vessel that is open at the top; used chiefly for holding food or liquids;

examples.en: Fill the big bowl with warm water for the cat.
examples.zh: 给猫的「碗」里倒满温水。

examples.en: Grandma always mixed the pancake batter in her biggest bowl.
examples.zh: 奶奶在她最大的「碗」里调煎饼糊。

words.enDefinition: not widely known; especially valued for its uncommonness

examples.en: It is rare to see snow in this southern city.
examples.zh: 在这座南方城市，「很少」见到下雪。

examples.en: Grandma's recipe uses a rare local herb for the marinade.
examples.zh: 奶奶的配方用了一种「稀有的」本地香草做腌汁。

words.enDefinition: an act of cleaning something, especially with water

examples.en: Give the dusty car a good wash before Sunday's trip.
examples.zh: 周日出行前把车好好「洗」一洗。

examples.en: That muddy white rugby jacket needs a hot wash tonight.
examples.zh: 那件沾满泥的橄榄球服今晚需要热水「洗」。

words.enDefinition: drop of the clear salty saline solution secreted by the lacrimal glands

examples.en: A tear rolled down her cheek during the last scene.
examples.zh: 最后一幕时，一滴「泪」顺着她的脸颊滑落。

examples.en: He quickly wiped away the tears and smiled at us.
examples.zh: 他擦掉「眼泪」，朝我们笑了笑。

words.enDefinition: an enclosed armored military vehicle; has a cannon and moves on caterpillar treads

examples.en: The old war film showed tanks crossing the muddy field.
examples.zh: 那部老战争片里，「坦克」驶过泥泞的田野。

examples.en: A single military tank rumbled through the small town square.
examples.zh: 一辆军用「坦克」隆隆驶过小镇广场。

words.enDefinition: heavy ductile magnetic metallic element; is silver-white in pure form but readily rusts; used in construction and tools and armament; plays a role in the transport of oxygen by the blood

examples.en: The fence around the park is made of wrought iron.
examples.zh: 公园周围的栅栏由熟「铁」制成。

examples.en: Spinach and red meat are good sources of dietary iron.
examples.zh: 菠菜和红肉是膳食「铁」的良好来源。

words.enDefinition: protective covering that covers or forms the top of a building

examples.en: Rain water leaked through the kitchen roof during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，雨水从厨房「屋顶」渗了进来。

examples.en: Local workers replaced the church roof before the winter rains.
examples.zh: 工人们在冬雨来临前换掉了教堂「屋顶」。

words.enDefinition: white nutritious liquid secreted by mammals and used as food by human beings

examples.en: The milk expired yesterday, so I will buy more today.
examples.zh: 「牛奶」昨天过期了，我今天再多买些。

examples.en: A glass of warm milk before bed helps some people fall asleep.
examples.zh: 睡前喝温「牛奶」对有些人有助眠作用。

words.enDefinition: to make a liquid flow from a container into somewhere else

examples.en: Pour the pancake batter slowly into the hot frying pan.
examples.zh: 把煎饼糊慢慢「倒」进热锅里。

examples.en: The heavy rain poured down the classroom windows all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午，雨「倾泻」在教室的窗上。

words.enDefinition: prominent or sensational but short-lived news event

examples.en: Stir the vegetable soup gently so the pieces stay whole.
examples.zh: 轻轻「搅动」汤，别把蔬菜搅散。

examples.en: One single quick glance at the painting stirred old memories.
examples.zh: 看一眼这幅画就「激起」了旧日回忆。

words.enDefinition: man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength

examples.en: The retired firefighter is a hero to the whole street.
examples.zh: 那位退役消防员是整条街的「英雄」。

examples.en: In the story, the hero rescues the village from the flood.
examples.zh: 故事里，「英雄」把村庄从洪水中救了出来。

words.enDefinition: unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope

examples.en: The vast ocean stretched to the horizon without a sail.
examples.zh: 「浩瀚的」大海上没有一片帆，一直延伸到天际。

examples.en: She has a vast collection of postcards from her travels.
examples.zh: 她收藏了「大量」旅行时寄来的明信片。

words.enDefinition: small group of indispensable persons or things

examples.en: The CORE of the business is its loyal morning customers.
examples.zh: 这门生意的「核心」是那些忠实的晨间老顾客。

examples.en: Trust is truly the CORE of every good neighbourhood shop.
examples.zh: 「信任」是每个好的街坊小店的核心。

words.enDefinition: sudden forceful flow

examples.en: There is no rush; finish the report whenever it is ready.
examples.zh: 不用「赶」，报告什么时候好就什么时候交。

examples.en: He felt a rush of cold air when the door opened.
examples.zh: 门一开，一股冷气「涌」了进来。

words.enDefinition: short for railway

examples.en: Engineering crews are welding new rails along the mountain route.
examples.zh: 工人们正沿山区线路焊接新「铁轨」。

examples.en: Steel rails carry the night train safely over the viaduct.
examples.zh: 钢「轨」载着夜行列车安全驶过高架桥。

words.enDefinition: cloak that is folded or wrapped around a person

examples.en: She wore a warm wool wrap over her evening dress.
examples.zh: 她在晚礼服外披了条保暖的羊毛「披肩」。

examples.en: Grandma's old silk wrap still looks lovely after forty years.
examples.zh: 四十年过去了，奶奶的丝「披巾」依旧好看。

words.enDefinition: the act of pulling something heavy along; something that makes progress slow or boring

examples.en: The heavy drag of the suitcase up the stairs exhausted him.
examples.zh: 把行李箱在楼梯上「拖」上楼让他筋疲力尽。

examples.en: Sitting through three hours of paperwork is a real drag.
examples.zh: 枯坐三个小时填表格真是件「烦人的苦差」。

words.enDefinition: an outer garment that has sleeves and covers the body from shoulder down; worn outdoors

examples.en: Hang your wet rain coat by the door to dry.
examples.zh: 把湿「外套」挂在门边晾干。

examples.en: This wool coat keeps me warm through the whole winter.
examples.zh: 这件「大衣」让我整个冬天都暖和。

words.enDefinition: unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot

examples.en: The garden rain gauge collected more than three inches overnight.
examples.zh: 雨量计一夜之间收集了三「英寸」多的雨水。

examples.en: He measured the wooden shelf carefully to the nearest inch.
examples.zh: 他仔细地把书架量到精确到「英寸」。

words.enDefinition: a small piece that has broken off from something hard; a small thin piece of food

examples.en: Fresh wood chips covered the workshop floor after the sawing.
examples.zh: 锯完木头后，车间地板上满是「木屑」。

examples.en: Sprinkle the dark chocolate chips evenly over the cake batter.
examples.zh: 把「巧克力碎粒」均匀撒在蛋糕糊上。

words.enDefinition: your consciousness of your own identity

examples.en: He looked at his reflection and questioned his whole self.
examples.zh: 他望着镜中的自己，质疑起整个「自我」。

examples.en: Writing a private diary helped her understand her inner self.
examples.zh: 写日记帮她理解了「内在的自我」。

words.enDefinition: place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country

examples.en: The huge cruise ship finally left port just after sunrise.
examples.zh: 游轮终于在日出后离开了「港口」。

examples.en: Most of the town's income comes from the fishing port.
examples.zh: 小镇大部分收入来自「渔港」。

words.enDefinition: with or in a close or intimate relationship

examples.en: You are such a dear for helping with the move.
examples.zh: 你帮忙搬家，真是个「亲爱的好孩子」。

examples.en: Come in, my dear, and warm yourself by the fire.
examples.zh: 进来吧，「亲爱的」，到炉火边暖暖身子。

words.enDefinition: footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg

examples.en: Lace up your old hiking boots before the muddy trail.
examples.zh: 走泥泞步道前系好登山「靴」。

examples.en: Snow slipped into my boot while I cleared the path.
examples.zh: 铲雪时，「雪」灌进了我的「靴子」。

words.enDefinition: composition written in metrical feet forming rhythmical lines

examples.en: She wrote a short funny poem for the school magazine.
examples.zh: 她为校刊写了一首短「诗」。

examples.en: This very ancient poem is still recited at every festival.
examples.zh: 这首古诗至今仍在每个节日被「传诵」。

words.enDefinition: showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy

examples.en: I am so very glad you could join us tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚你能来，我非常「高兴」。

examples.en: She was really glad the storm passed before the fair.
examples.zh: 集市开张前风暴就过去了，她很「庆幸」。

words.enDefinition: to move an object or part of your body so that it is no longer straight

examples.en: Bend the wire gently into a circle for the wreath.
examples.zh: 把铁丝轻轻「弯」成圆圈做花环。

examples.en: Bend down very slowly to pick up the dropped coins.
examples.zh: 捡起掉落的硬币时要慢慢「弯腰」。

words.enDefinition: loose material consisting of grains of rock or coral

examples.en: The children built a big castle out of wet sand.
examples.zh: 孩子们用湿「沙」堆了一座城堡。

examples.en: Strong wind blew sand across the coastal road all morning.
examples.zh: 整个上午，「风沙」一直吹过沿海公路。

words.enDefinition: weight to be borne or conveyed

examples.en: The van carried a heavy load of bricks to the site.
examples.zh: 面包车载着沉重的砖块「负荷」开往工地。

examples.en: Ease the heavy load carefully off your back before climbing.
examples.zh: 爬坡前先卸下背上的重「负」。

words.enDefinition: fastener fitted to a door or drawer to keep it firmly closed

examples.en: The old brass key snapped right inside the rusty lock.
examples.zh: 旧钥匙正好折断在生锈的「锁」里。

examples.en: Always check the door lock twice before leaving the workshop.
examples.zh: 离开车间前务必检查两遍「门锁」。

words.enDefinition: posture assumed by models for photographic or artistic purposes

examples.en: The wedding photographer asked her to change her pose slightly.
examples.zh: 摄影师请她稍稍换个「姿势」。

examples.en: He deliberately struck a funny pose for the family photo.
examples.zh: 拍全家福时他摆了个滑稽的「造型」。

words.enDefinition: humorous anecdote or remark intended to provoke laughter

examples.en: His joke about the weather broke the ice at dinner.
examples.zh: 他拿天气开的「玩笑」打破了晚餐的拘谨。

examples.en: Nobody really understood the joke, but everyone still laughed politely.
examples.zh: 没人真听懂那个「笑话」，但大家都礼貌地笑了。

words.enDefinition: fine powdery material such as dry earth or pollen that can be blown about in the air

examples.en: Grey dust gathered on the bookshelf over the long winter.
examples.zh: 漫长的冬天里，书架上积了「灰尘」。

examples.en: Wipe the dust off the plants with a damp cloth.
examples.zh: 用湿布擦掉植物上的「灰尘」。

words.enDefinition: very interested in and enthusiastic about something; eager

examples.en: She is keen on photography and joins every photo walk.
examples.zh: 她「热衷于」摄影，每次外拍都参加。

examples.en: He is a keen young swimmer, training before school daily.
examples.zh: 他是个「热心的」游泳爱好者，每天上学前训练。

words.enDefinition: the act of caressing with the lips (or an instance thereof)

examples.en: She gave her sleepy son a kiss on the forehead.
examples.zh: 她在睡眼惺忪的儿子额头上印下一个「吻」。

examples.en: The bride blew a kiss to her grandparents in the front row.
examples.zh: 新娘向前排的祖父母「飞吻」。

words.enDefinition: a sweet baked food made from flour, sugar, eggs and fat

examples.en: Mum baked a lovely lemon cake for the neighbours' party.
examples.zh: 妈妈为邻居聚会「烤」了一个柠檬「蛋糕」。

examples.en: The whole chocolate cake disappeared before the candles were lit.
examples.zh: 蜡烛还没点，巧克力「蛋糕」就被吃光了。

words.enDefinition: the top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill)

examples.en: We reached the windy peak before the clouds rolled in.
examples.zh: 云层涌来之前，我们登上了「山顶」。

examples.en: The little hotel sits just below the mountain's snowy peak.
examples.zh: 酒店坐落在「山峰」雪线之下不远处。

words.enDefinition: (of skin or light) whitish and lacking colour

examples.en: He looked pale and shaky after the long ferry crossing.
examples.zh: 长时间乘船之后，他脸色「苍白」，身子发虚。

examples.en: The pale weak winter sun barely warmed the frozen garden.
examples.zh: 「苍白」的冬日阳光几乎暖不了冰冻的花园。

words.enDefinition: ligament made of metal and used to fasten things or make cages or fences etc

examples.en: The young electrician stripped the wire before joining the cables.
examples.zh: 电工剥开「电线」再接线。

examples.en: A loose blue wire sparked quietly behind the old television.
examples.zh: 旧电视机后面一根松动的「电线」悄悄打着火花。

words.enDefinition: belonging to or derived from or associated with a divine power

examples.en: The ancient holy festival fills the temple streets with music.
examples.zh: 「神圣的」节日让寺庙街道充满音乐。

examples.en: The pilgrims walked for days to reach the holy mountain.
examples.zh: 朝圣者们走了好几天才到达「圣山」。

words.enDefinition: either of two offspring born at the same time from the same pregnancy

examples.en: One twin is very quiet; the other never stops talking.
examples.zh: 这对「双胞胎」一个安静，另一个说个不停。

examples.en: As a twin, she shares birthdays, jokes, and even jumpers.
examples.zh: 作为「双胞胎」之一，她连生日、玩笑甚至毛衣都和妹妹共享。

words.enDefinition: an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another

examples.en: Finding that parking space by the market was pure luck.
examples.zh: 在市场旁找到那个车位纯属「运气」。

examples.en: Good luck with the interview tomorrow; you will be great.
examples.zh: 祝你明天面试「好运」，你一定行的。

words.enDefinition: payment or series of payments made by the lessee to an owner for use of some property, facility, equipment, or service

examples.en: The rent for the small flat includes all water charges.
examples.zh: 这套小公寓的「房租」包含全部水费。

examples.en: They split the monthly rent three ways to save money.
examples.zh: 为了省钱，他们三人平摊「租金」。

words.enDefinition: cover from sight

examples.en: The dog quickly buried its bone somewhere in the flowerbed.
examples.zh: 狗把「骨头」埋在了花坛的某个地方。

examples.en: The villagers buried the time capsule beneath the old oak.
examples.zh: 村民们在老橡树下「埋」下了时间胶囊。

words.enDefinition: a tube that carries water or gas from one place to another

examples.en: A burst water pipe flooded the kitchen on Sunday night.
examples.zh: 周日晚上，一根爆裂的「水管」淹了厨房。

examples.en: The local plumber replaced the rusty pipe under the sink.
examples.zh: 水管工更换了水槽下生锈的「管子」。

words.enDefinition: small pond of standing water

examples.en: The sheep grazed quietly beside the shallow mere at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，羊群在浅「湖」边安静地吃草。

examples.en: A thin grey mist floated over the mere before sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出前，薄雾漂浮在小「湖」上。

words.enDefinition: emblem usually consisting of a rectangular piece of cloth of distinctive design

examples.en: The national flag flies above the town hall every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上，「国旗」都在市政厅上空飘扬。

examples.en: A red warning flag tells swimmers to stay away from the rocks.
examples.zh: 一面红旗「警示」游泳者远离礁石。

words.enDefinition: the natural satellite of the Earth

examples.en: The full moon rose over the lake just after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后不久，「月亮」从湖面升起。

examples.en: A bright full moon lit the whole valley that night.
examples.zh: 那晚，一轮「满月」照亮了整个山谷。

words.enDefinition: the yield from plants in a single growing season

examples.en: Wheat has been the main crop in this region for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，小麦一直是这个地区的主要「农作物」。

examples.en: The farmers covered the young crop against the late frost.
examples.zh: 农民们盖住幼小的「庄稼」以防晚霜。

words.enDefinition: the rate of moving (especially walking or running)

examples.en: She set a slow steady pace for the long climb.
examples.zh: 长途攀登中她保持着平稳的「步速」。

examples.en: The whole town moves at a slower pace in August.
examples.zh: 八月里，这座小镇的节奏「慢」了下来。

words.enDefinition: a position in a scale of status or importance

examples.en: He joined the police and rose to the rank of inspector.
examples.zh: 他加入警队，一路升到了「警衔」中的督察级。

examples.en: In the army, his high rank earned him quiet respect.
examples.zh: 在军队里，他的「军衔」为他赢得了默默的敬重。

words.enDefinition: the bags of letters and packages that are transported by the postal service

examples.en: The mail reaches our small office around ten each morning.
examples.zh: 「邮件」每天早上十点左右送到我们办公室。

examples.en: There is a small parcel in today's mail for you.
examples.zh: 今天的「邮件」里有个给你的小包裹。

words.enDefinition: light shade of red

examples.en: The walls of the new nursery are painted soft pink.
examples.zh: 育婴室的墙刷成了柔和的「粉红色」。

examples.en: Pale pink cherry blossom covered the orchard in early April.
examples.zh: 四月初，「粉红色的」花覆盖了果园。

words.enDefinition: conduit consisting of a long hollow object (usually cylindrical) used to hold and conduct objects or liquids or gases

examples.en: Squeeze the very last of the toothpaste from the tube.
examples.zh: 把「牙膏管」里最后一点牙膏挤出来。

examples.en: The water travels through a clear plastic tube into the tank.
examples.zh: 水通过塑料「管」流进水箱。

words.enDefinition: plumbing fixture consisting of a water basin fixed to a wall or floor and having a drainpipe

examples.en: The dirty dishes piled up in the kitchen sink overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间，脏盘子在厨房「水槽」里堆了起来。

examples.en: She rinsed the fresh lettuce leaves under the sink tap.
examples.zh: 她在「洗碗池」的水龙头下冲洗生菜叶。

words.enDefinition: the posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body

examples.en: The dog wagged its tail the moment I came home.
examples.zh: 我一到家，狗就摇起了「尾巴」。

examples.en: The comet's glowing tail brightens as it nears the sun.
examples.zh: 彗星接近太阳时，「彗尾」会发光。

words.enDefinition: toothed wheel that engages another toothed mechanism in order to change the speed or direction of transmitted motion

examples.en: Shift down a gear before you reach the steep hill.
examples.zh: 到陡坡前先「换」低一「挡」。

examples.en: The bicycle's rear gear needs oil after the wet ride.
examples.zh: 雨骑之后，自行车的后「变速齿轮」需要上油。

words.enDefinition: swift whirling motion (usually of a missile)

examples.en: The skater finished her final spin with one arm raised.
examples.zh: 滑冰选手完成最后一个「旋转」时单臂上扬。

examples.en: The old washing machine's spin cycle is surprisingly quiet now.
examples.zh: 洗衣机的「甩干」转动现在安静得出奇。

words.enDefinition: hollow device made of metal that makes a ringing sound when struck

examples.en: The old bronze church bell rang eight times at noon.
examples.zh: 中午，古老的教堂「钟」敲了八下。

examples.en: A tiny brass bell hangs cheerfully above the shop door.
examples.zh: 店门上方挂着一只小铜「铃」。

words.enDefinition: grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished

examples.en: Rinse the rice very well twice before you cook it.
examples.zh: 煮之前把「米」淘洗两遍。

examples.en: Fried rice with fried egg is our Friday night tradition.
examples.zh: 蛋炒「饭」是我们周五夜晚的传统。

words.enDefinition: cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven

examples.en: We bake bread every Sunday morning in the stone oven.
examples.zh: 每周日早上我们都在石炉里「烤」面包。

examples.en: Mum likes to bake a cake for every family birthday.
examples.zh: 妈妈喜欢为每个家人生日「烘焙」一个蛋糕。

words.enDefinition: up to a particular time; until

examples.en: The little local museum stays open till eight on Fridays.
examples.zh: 周五这家小博物馆一直开放「到」八点。

examples.en: Wait right here till I fetch the tickets from the office.
examples.zh: 就在这里等着，「直到」我从办公室取来票。

words.enDefinition: an act or period of swimming

examples.en: Let us all go for a quick swim before lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭前我们去「游泳」一会儿吧。

examples.en: A short swim in the sea woke us all up.
examples.zh: 在海里「游」了一小会儿，大家都精神了。

words.enDefinition: large piece of fabric (usually canvas fabric) by means of which wind is used to propel a sailing vessel

examples.en: They raised the sail as soon as the boat left the dock.
examples.zh: 船一离开码头他们就「扬帆」了。

examples.en: A badly torn sail means a very slow trip home.
examples.zh: 「帆」破了，回家的航程就会很慢。

words.enDefinition: a small piece of land used for a particular purpose, such as growing vegetables

examples.en: Grandpa grows tomatoes on a small plot behind the sheds.
examples.zh: 爷爷在小屋后的一小块「地里」种番茄。

examples.en: They finally bought a building plot near the new school.
examples.zh: 他们买下了新学校附近的一块建筑「用地」。

words.enDefinition: collection of objects laid on top of each other

examples.en: There is a pile of unread letters on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上堆着一「摞」没读的信。

examples.en: The happy kids jumped into the pile of raked leaves.
examples.zh: 孩子们跳进了耙成的一「堆堆」落叶里。

words.enDefinition: a friend or companion; someone who shares an activity with you

examples.en: He has been my best mate since we started primary school.
examples.zh: 从小学起他就是我最好的「伙伴」。

examples.en: My old mates from the football team meet every Saturday.
examples.zh: 足球队的「老伙伴们」每周六聚一次。

words.enDefinition: able to make good decisions using knowledge and experience

examples.en: It was a wise decision to insure the van early.
examples.zh: 早早给货车投保是个「明智的」决定。

examples.en: Grandma's wise advice saved us from a really bad contract.
examples.zh: 奶奶「明智的」建议让我们避开了一份糟糕的合同。

words.enDefinition: freedom from difficulty or hardship or effort

examples.en: He lifted the heavy box with surprising ease and speed.
examples.zh: 他「轻松」而敏捷地抬起了重箱子。

examples.en: The painkillers gave her enough ease to sleep at last.
examples.zh: 止痛药让她终于「轻松」得可以入睡。

words.enDefinition: characterized by or producing sound of great volume or intensity

examples.en: The very loud music from next door kept us awake.
examples.zh: 隔壁「大声的」音乐让我们睡不着。

examples.en: She gave a loud laugh that filled the whole cafe.
examples.zh: 她「响亮的」笑声充满了整间咖啡馆。

words.enDefinition: physical or mental damage or injury

examples.en: Smoking does real lasting harm to your lungs over time.
examples.zh: 吸烟日久对肺有实实在在的「伤害」。

examples.en: The weekend storm caused little harm to the harbour boats.
examples.zh: 风暴对港口船只几乎没有造成「损害」。

words.enDefinition: challenge to do something dangerous or foolhardy

examples.en: She accepted the dare and climbed to the top of the wall.
examples.zh: 她接受了这个「挑战」，爬到了墙顶。

examples.en: It started as a dare and ended with everyone in the fountain.
examples.zh: 这原本只是个「打赌式的挑衅」，结果人人都跳进了喷泉。

words.enDefinition: device in which something (usually an animal) can be caught and penned

examples.en: The patient hunter checked his traps at sunrise every day.
examples.zh: 猎人每天日出时查看他的「陷阱」。

examples.en: The final trick question was a trap for careless readers.
examples.zh: 这道刁钻的题是个抓粗心读者的「圈套」。

words.enDefinition: an organization of military vessels belonging to a country and available for sea warfare

examples.en: Her older brother serves in the navy on a destroyer.
examples.zh: 她哥哥在「海军」的一艘驱逐舰上服役。

examples.en: The navy helicopter rescued the fishermen during the night storm.
examples.zh: 夜间的风暴中，「海军」救起了渔民。

words.enDefinition: state of confusion and disorderliness

examples.en: What a terrible mess the puppies made of the newspaper!
examples.zh: 小狗把报纸弄得一团「糟」！

examples.en: His desk is always a mess of tools and sketches.
examples.zh: 他的书桌总是「乱七八糟」，堆满工具和草图。

words.enDefinition: to pursue and kill or catch wild animals; to search for something

examples.en: Barn owls hunt small animals across the fields at night.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰夜里在田野间「捕猎」小动物。

examples.en: Wolves hunt in packs at the edge of the forest.
examples.zh: 狼群在森林边缘结群「狩猎」。

words.enDefinition: something that resembles a tablet of medicine in shape or size

examples.en: Take one small white pill after each meal with water.
examples.zh: 每餐后用水服下一粒白色「药丸」。

examples.en: Grandma always keeps her morning pills in a labelled box.
examples.zh: 奶奶把早晨的「药丸」放在贴了标签的盒子里。

words.enDefinition: morally objectionable behavior

examples.en: In the old legend, the knight confronts an ancient evil.
examples.zh: 传说中，骑士直面一股古老的「邪恶」。

examples.en: Grandma always says gossip carries a little evil inside it.
examples.zh: 奶奶说闲话里藏着几分「恶意」。

words.enDefinition: an angular or rounded shape made by folding

examples.en: Make one sharp, clean fold along the dotted pencil line.
examples.zh: 沿虚线折出一道整齐的「折痕」。

examples.en: The linen dress falls in soft folds when she walks.
examples.zh: 她走路时，亚麻裙垂下柔软的「褶」。
